sp-06702.description_en: As Anticipate Missile, except applies to one melee attack that the caster is aware of.

sp-06703.description_en: When faced with a choice about which he has little or no information (e.g., which corridor leads outside the quickest) the caster may cast this spell and the Gamemaster will determine which way he goes, biasing the choice favorable by 25% (e.g, roll 1-100: correct on 26-100, incorrect on 01-25).

sp-06704.description_en: Caster can avoid one spell cast on him. The caster gets a bonus of +50 to his DB against a directed elemental attack; his normal DB against an area elemental attack; or the caster's BAR suffers a -10 penalty (on all other spell attacks).

sp-06705.description_en: Caster gains a vision of what will probably happen in the next minute if he takes a specified action.

sp-06706.description_en: Caster is aware of any being within the area of effect that has hostile intentions towards him. The hostility must be directed specifically at the caster or the spell reveals nothing. The being's hostility must be active (i.e., driving the being to perform aggressive actions), not passive (i.e., hate exists, but no action is planned).

sp-06707.description_en: Caster has a dream relating to a topic decided upon just before retiring. This spell can only be used once per night. The caster must sleep a minimum of one normal sleep cycle.

sp-06708.description_en: Caster has a vision of what has occurred in a room or place; limited to up to 1 minute per level into the past. The size of the room is limited to the area of effect.

sp-06709.description_en: Predicts most probable actions of a being in the next round; specifics are not learned (e.g., attack in melee, cast a spell; but no detail on attack target or what spell). This results in the caster being able to declare his statement of intent for the round after hearing what the target has decided to do. Note that the target is free to change his declared action with the requisite penalties.

sp-06710.description_en: As Intuitions I, except caster gets to gaze 2 minutes into the future.

sp-06711.description_en: As Room Feel I, except limit is 1 hr/lvl.

sp-06712.description_en: As Anticipate Hostility, except for area of effect, duration and range.

sp-06713.description_en: As Dream I, except limit is 2 dreams/night on different topics.

sp-06714.description_en: As Anticipations, except if action is to cast a spell, the spell to be cast and target are learned.

sp-06715.description_en: As Room Feel I, except limit is 1 day/lvl.

sp-06716.description_en: As Dream I, except limit is 3 dreams/night on different topics.

sp-06717.description_en: As Room Feel I, except limit is 1 week/ lvl.

sp-06718.description_en: As Intuitions I, except time limit extends 1 min/lvl into the future.

sp-06719.description_en: As Anticipations, except caster can predict actions of all beings within 100' of him.

sp-06720.description_en: As Dream I, except limit is 5 dreams/night on any combination of topics the caster chooses.

sp-06721.description_en: As Anticipations True, except spell types and targets are learned.

sp-06723.description_en: As Turn Missile, except applies to a melee attack.

sp-06724.description_en: Creates an invisible force shield in front of the caster; it subtracts 25 from melee and missile attacks and functions as a normal shield.

sp-06725.description_en: Deflects one missile fired at the caster; that missile has 100 subtracted from its attack (caster must be able to see the attack).

sp-06726.description_en: As Deflect I, except its effect is against one melee attack.

sp-06727.description_en: As Deflect I, except missile automatically misses.

sp-06728.description_en: Creates a pocket of still air 1" per level on all sides of the caster, that no outside gas can come into. The duration of the spell is how long it will take for one person to consume all the oxygen inside the pocket.

sp-06729.description_en: As Deflect I, except affects 2 missiles.

sp-06730.description_en: Deflects one elemental spell against caster. The attack roll has -50 added to it (must be in the caster's field of vision).

sp-06731.description_en: As Bladeturn I, except affects 2 melee attacks.

sp-06732.description_en: As Deflect I, except affects 3 missiles.

sp-06733.description_en: As Spell Deflect I, except affects 2 elemental attack spells.

sp-06734.description_en: As Bladeturn I, except affects 3 melee attacks.

sp-06735.description_en: As Spell Deflect I, except affects 3 elemental attack spells.

sp-06736.description_en: As Deflect I, Bladeturn I, and Spell Deflect I; except any 3 attacks can be deflected.

sp-06737.description_en: Beam of light (like a flashlight) springs from the caster's palm. This beam has a 50' effective range. When hand is made into a fist, the light will “shut off” until the fist is opened again.

sp-06738.description_en: Causes a small, 1" diameter point of light that will glow softly. This spell provides enough light for Nightvision to work properly; but not enough light to allow much mobility in the dark. See Section 7.1.19.

sp-06739.description_en: Lights a 10'R area about the point touched. If the point is on a mobile object or being, it will move with the object/ being. See Section 7.1.19.

sp-06740.description_en: Causes a bright aura about the caster, making him appear more powerful and subtracting 5 from all attacks.

sp-06741.description_en: [RR Mod: -10] Causes a 10'R sphere of intense light. All within are stunned for 1 round per 10 failure.

sp-06742.description_en: A bolt of intense, charged light is shot form the palm of the caster. Results are determined on the Shock Bolt Attack Table.

sp-06744.description_en: As Self Aura, except it makes him appear extremely powerful and subtracts 15 from all attacks.

sp-06745.description_en: As Light I, except radius is 50'.

sp-06747.description_en: Causes any object up to 1000 cubic feet to glow with any desired color.

sp-06748.description_en: Ray of light of any color springs from caster's hand. This ray can be up to 5 miles long.

sp-06749.description_en: As Darkness, except radius is 100' per level.

sp-06750.description_en: As Light, except radius is 100' and it is equivalent to full daylight. All magically created darkness is nullified for the duration.

sp-06751.description_en: Darkens a 100'R, no non-magical light can exist in the area and magic light (except for Utterlight) must make a RR or it is canceled.

sp-06752.description_en: Focuses sunlight as a lens, must be focused initially on a fixed point. After 1 round it can be moved at a rate of 1' per round. It will burn through a 1' diameter at a rate of 1' per round (for wood), 4" per round (for stone), or 1" per round (for metal). This spell cannot be used effectively in combat (as foes can easily move out of the way). However, if used on an immobile foe, see Hand of Fire for damage resolution process.

sp-06753.description_en: As Sunfires, except doesn't need sunlight.

sp-06754.description_en: As Sunfires, except the range and focus is 6" from open palm of caster (caster's arm is immune) and it can be moved 10' per round. It can be used in melee; striking on the Fire Bolt Attack Table (deliver double concussion hits) with an OB equal to (30 + caster's directed spell skill bonus with Hand of Fire). If the attack is fumbled (01-02 UM), the caster takes an automatic 'C' Heat Critical.

sp-06755.description_en: As Hand of Fire, except doesn't need sunlight.

sp-06756.description_en: Causes caster to appear blurred to attackers, subtracting 10 from all attacks.

sp-06757.description_en: Caster and objects on his person appear to be a shadow; and thus are almost invisible in dark areas (e.g., in many situations this could be handled with a Stalking/Hiding bonus between 25 and 75).

sp-06758.description_en: A single object is made invisible (1 garment, 1 naked body, etc.); until 24 hrs pass or the object is struck by a violent blow (being hit by a weapon, falling, etc.) or the object makes a violent move (i.e., an attack).

sp-06759.description_en: [RR Mod = -50] Target makes an RR. Failure results in the caster being invisible to the target; others see the caster normally. If the caster makes an obvious action (e.g., talking, moving an object, etc.), the target may make another RR (the GM may deem it appropriate to apply modifiers to this RR based upon the action the caster takes). If the caster attacks the target, he may make another RR with a +50 modifier. If the caster begins to concentrate (50% activity), he can extend the duration of this spell indefinitely (as long as he can concentrate).

sp-06760.description_en: A limited illusion that allows the caster to look like any humanoid figure within 20% of his own size.

sp-06761.description_en: As Cloaking I, except the caster can affect 3 targets (the caster makes one BAR that applies to all targets).

sp-06762.description_en: As Cloaking I, except every target in the area of effect must make a RR (one BAR a round for all targets). Once a target makes a successful RR, he need not make another RR against the spell.

sp-06763.description_en: As Cloaking I, except the caster can affect 5

sp-06764.description_en: As Cloaking Sphere I, except for the area of effect.

sp-06765.description_en: Creates a duplicate of the caster; if he concentrates, it will move as he wills; otherwise, it does exactly as he does. The duplicate is limited to moving within in the area of effect. If the caster concentrates, he can “merge” the duplicate with himself and then split back apart again (making it difficult to discern which one is the “real” caster).

sp-06766.description_en: As Facades I, except illusion may include sounds and voices.

sp-06767.description_en: As Cloaking I, except the caster can affect 10 targets (the caster makes one BAR that applies to all targets).

sp-06768.description_en: As Cloaking Sphere I, except for the area of effect.

sp-06769.description_en: Caster appears to be offset from where he really is. All attacks have no effect 10% of the time (no normal RRs). Each time a foe misses him, the chance of “no effect” for that foe goes down by 5%.

sp-06770.description_en: Caster and objects on his person take on the visual texture, color, and form of surrounding area. Caster is nearly invisible when motionless (+200 to all Hiding maneuvers) and has a +50 bonus to Stalking attempts (if he concentrates). This spell is not cumulative with Shadow.

sp-06771.description_en: As Cloaking I, except the caster can affect 20 targets (the caster makes one BAR that applies to all targets).

sp-06773.description_en: As Cloaking Sphere I, except for the area of effect.

sp-06774.description_en: As Shadow Mentalist I, except there are two duplicates.

sp-06775.description_en: As Displacement I, except “no effect” chance is 30%.

sp-06776.description_en: As Camouflage, except doesn't require concentration while moving and the Stalking bonus is 75.

sp-06777.description_en: As Cloaking I, except the caster can affect as many targets as he has levels and the range is only limited to the caster's field of vision.

sp-06778.description_en: Caster is protected from natural heat up to 170˚F (treat as if target were in 70˚F temperature). For temperatures above 170˚F, subtract 100˚F to determine the effective temperature for the target. Caster also receives +20 to all RRs versus heat spells and heat attacks (+20 DB versus elemental fire and heat attacks).

sp-06779.description_en: Caster is protected from natural cold down to 20˚F (treat as if target were in 70˚F temperature). For temperatures below 20˚F, add 50˚F to determine the effective temperature for the target. Caster also receives +20 to all RRs versus cold spells and cold attacks (+20 DB versus elemental cold and cold attacks).

sp-06780.description_en: Caster is able to sustain an additional 25% of his total concussion hits (round off) before passing out. Hits are still taken and remain when the duration expires.

sp-06781.description_en: I — Relieves 1 round's worth of accumulated stun.

sp-06783.description_en: As Unpain I, except 50% additional hits may be sustained.

sp-06784.description_en: As Stun Relief I, except 3 rounds are relieved.

sp-06785.description_en: Has a 50% chance of neutralizing a poison (modified by potency of the poison) if the caster is unconscious or concentrates for one hour. In any case, it delays the poison for as long as the caster can concentrate.

sp-06786.description_en: Will awaken the caster from any unnatural sleep (e.g., Sleep spell, sleeping drug, etc.). Caster takes one round to awaken.

sp-06787.description_en: As Unpain I, except 75% additional hits may be sustained.

sp-06788.description_en: As Heat Resistance, except caster is immune to natural heat and takes 50% normal damage from heat spells.

sp-06789.description_en: As Cold Resistance, except caster is also immune to natural cold and takes 50% normal damage from cold spells.

sp-06790.description_en: As Unpain I, except 100% additional hits may be sustained.

sp-06791.description_en: As Neutralize Poison, except chance of neutralization is 100% (modified).

sp-06792.description_en: As Awake, except there is no delay and it can be used with normal sleep and set to be triggered by any activity (e.g., attack, danger, etc.).

sp-06793.description_en: As Unpain IV, except caster ignores all pain. He will be active until he takes more than: [2 x normal hits + Temporary Constitution]. He ignores all penalties due to wounds (i.e., negative modifications to actions). When he exceeds this limit, he does not pass out; he dies from system shock.

sp-06794.description_en: Caster receives basic idea of item's purpose, if any.

sp-06795.description_en: Detects power in an object, but not what realm or how much; caster may concentrate on a different object each round.

sp-06796.description_en: Gives a general idea of the place of origin of an item.

sp-06797.description_en: Detects if a curse is on an item.

sp-06798.description_en: Gives the origins of an item's power.

sp-06799.description_en: Gives details of where, when, and how the examined piece of rock was worked.

sp-06800.description_en: Gives a vision of a significant event in the item's past.

sp-06801.description_en: Gives significant details about an item's construction and purpose (not specific powers).

sp-06802.description_en: Caster gets a vision up to 1 hour per level into the past. The desired time can be set within ±30 min. The vision must be associated with an item or place. The vision can last up to 1 minute per level if the caster concentrates and remains inactive.

sp-06803.description_en: Gives major abilities and powers of an item.

sp-06804.description_en: Gives a vision of how someone died and an image of their killer. This spell must be cast within 24 hours of the death. In addition, this spell must be cast at the place of death or in the presence of the dead body.

sp-06805.description_en: When cast just before a Past Vision spell, it allows caster to lock onto a specific event in an item's past, and then examine that event with a Past Vision.

sp-06806.description_en: Gives a complete rundown on an item's construction, powers, and purpose (may be modified if an item is extremely powerful).

sp-06807.description_en: As Past Vision I, except time range is 1 day per level (with an error of ±1 hour) and the vision can last up to 10 minutes per level.

sp-06808.description_en: As Past Vision I, except time range is 1 month/lvl (with an error of ±1 day) and the vision can last up to 1 hour per level.

sp-06809.description_en: As Past Vision I, except time range is 1 year per level (with an error of ±1 week) and the vision can last up to 5 hours per level.

sp-06810.description_en: As Past Vision I, except time range is 10 year per level (with an error of ±1 month) and vision can last up to 10 hours per level (each hour of the past event takes only 10 minutes real time).

sp-06811.description_en: Detects any active spell or item from the Mentalism realm; caster can concentrate on a 5'R area each round.

sp-06812.description_en: As Detect Mentalism, except realm is Essence.

sp-06813.description_en: As Detect Mentalism, except realm is Channeling.

sp-06814.description_en: As Detect Mentalism, except caster can detect extremes of emotion (e.g., hatred, love, sadness, etc.). In addition, the caster learns which emotions the target is feeling is extreme. If there are no extremes of emotion (i.e., only normal feelings), this spell detects nothing.

sp-06815.description_en: As Detect Mentalism, except detects all invisible things; all attacks against something so detected are at -50. See Section 7.1.10.

sp-06816.description_en: As Detect Mentalism, except detects if a being is evil or an item created by evil or long used by a very evil person.

sp-06817.description_en: As Detect Mentalism, except that it gives a 75% chance of detecting a trap (trap sophistication modifiers may reduce or enhance this chance). See Section 7.1.29.

sp-06818.description_en: As Detect Mentalism, except it will give an estimate of the power (i.e., level) of the person or item or spell examined.

sp-06819.description_en: As Detect Mentalism, except it analyzes general spell type (in item or cast) and what list is was cast from. In the case of a person it gives the person's profession.

sp-06820.description_en: As Perceive Power I, except range is 100' and area is 10'R.

sp-06821.description_en: As Detect Invisible, except caster can see invisible things anywhere he can normally see. In addition, his attacks suffer no penalties against invisible targets he can see.

sp-06822.description_en: As Detect Mentalism, except detects any spells that have ever been cast in the area examined. The caster will know the spell type and the list it was cast from.

sp-06823.description_en: As above, except range is 500' and area is 50'R.

sp-06824.description_en: As Power Typing, except exact spell type is known for every spell thrown in the area.

sp-06825.description_en: As above, except range is 1 mile and area of effect is 300'R.

sp-06826.description_en: Gives the direction and distance to any specific object or place that the caster is familiar with or has had described in detail.

sp-06827.description_en: As Detect Mentalism, except any of the lower level “detect” spells can be used, one per round.

sp-06828.description_en: Any or all of the lower level non-Location spells on this list may be used simultaneously.

sp-06829.description_en: Makes an inanimate object (up to 1000 cubic feet) appear to be 10' to one side of its actual location.

sp-06830.description_en: Creates any simple immobile image or scene up to 10'R or any constant (including repetitive) sounds coming from a 10'R.

sp-06831.description_en: Creates a simple immobile image or scene up to an area of 10'R. One of the following options may also be chosen: a) sound can be added to the illusion or b) the duration can be doubled or c) the range can be doubled or d) the radius of effect can be doubled. Note that all parts of the area of effect must be within the range of the spell.

sp-06832.description_en: Creates the image of one object or being, that will move however the caster wants while he concentrates. When the caster stops concentrating the image remains, but stops moving (the caster can resume concentration later and resume moving the phantasm). The image can be any size that would fit into a 10'R sphere.

sp-06834.description_en: As Illusion II, except two of the options can be chosen.

sp-06835.description_en: As Light/Sound Mirage, except the spell can be delayed up to 24 hours or until triggered by: a) time period, b) specified movements, or c) specified sounds.

sp-06836.description_en: As Illusion II, except three of the options can be chosen.

sp-06837.description_en: As Phantasm I, except one of the following options may also be chosen: a) sound can be added or b) the duration can be doubled or c) the radius of the sphere limiting the size of the image can be doubled or d) the range can be doubled or e) another image can be created and moved (all separate phantasms that move must be within the caster's field of vision and within range of the spell).

sp-06838.description_en: An Illusion II, but can be delayed as in Waiting Illusion I.

sp-06839.description_en: As Illusion II, except four of the options can be chosen.

sp-06840.description_en: As Phantasm II, except two of the options can be chosen.

sp-06841.description_en: As Illusion III, except can be delayed as in Waiting Illusion I.

sp-06842.description_en: As Illusion II, except six of the options can be chosen.

sp-06843.description_en: As Illusion V, except can be delayed as in Waiting Illusion I.

sp-06844.description_en: As Illusion II, except nine of the options can be chosen.

sp-06845.description_en: As Phantasm II, except four of the options can be chosen.

sp-06846.description_en: Clots wound to reduce bleeding (i.e., hits per round damage) by one as long as caster concentrates or is immobile. This effect is permanent after hour. If caster is unconscious, with spell will concentrate without concentration.

sp-06847.description_en: As Clot I, except bleeding is reduced by up to 3 hits per round.

sp-06848.description_en: Heals 1 hit per minute for as long as the caster concentrates. If caster is unconscious, this spell will operate without concentration.

sp-06849.description_en: Concentrating with this spell for 2 hours will repair a broken bone (though not a shattered or destroyed bone).

sp-06850.description_en: As Clot I, except it is permanent immediately.

sp-06851.description_en: As Fracture Repair I, except damaged muscles or tendons may be repaired.

sp-06852.description_en: Repairs minor damage to one nerve. Requires a 1 day recovery period. Minor damage is defined as any nerve damage that results in penalties up to -20.

sp-06853.description_en: Concentrating with this spell for 2 hours per day for 1-10 days (depending on the severity) will repair any external damage to the caster's ear (including ear loss) or eye (including corneal scratches, removal of foreign objects, etc.).

sp-06854.description_en: As Fracture Repair, except repairs a vein or an artery.

sp-06855.description_en: As Pain Relief I, except 2 hits per minute are healed.

sp-06856.description_en: Upon receiving a death blow, the caster goes into a state of suspended animation. The caster will remain in this state until he is cured or his brain is destroyed.

sp-06857.description_en: Allows caster to reattach a severed limb; limb is fully functional after 1-10 days (caster must concentrate with this spell 2 hours each day).

sp-06858.description_en: As Pain Relief I, except heals 1 hit per round.

sp-06859.description_en: Concentrating with this spell for 2 hours per day for 10-100 days will regenerate a limb.

sp-06860.description_en: After any organ (except brain) is destroyed, the caster may use Self Keeping and this spell. The organ is regenerated after 10-100 days of complete inactivity.

sp-06861.description_en: As Organ Regeneration, except all damage (except brain) is regenerated in 10-100 days.

sp-06862.description_en: Subtracts 5 from elemental attack rolls against the caster and adds 5 to all of the caster's RRs vs. spells.

sp-06863.description_en: When the caster is a target of a spell from the Mentalism, the “incoming” spell must first make an RR before the caster makes an RR. For RR purposes, each spell uses a level equal its caster's level. If the “incoming” spell passes the RR, it may target the caster of this spell normally; otherwise the incoming spell has no effect on this target.

sp-06864.description_en: As Cancel Mentalism, except affects spells from the realm of Essence.

sp-06865.description_en: As Protection I, except bonuses are 10.

sp-06866.description_en: As Cancel Mentalism, except affects spells from the realm of Channeling.

sp-06867.description_en: Creates a shimmering shield in front of the caster. The shield subtracts 10 from all frontal Mentalism attack rolls on the caster (base and elemental). If the caster performs no other actions during a round, he can “parry” (as with a normal shield) one spell attack. The parry bonus is equal to the sum of all the bonuses that the caster would normally have for his spell's base attack roll.

sp-06868.description_en: As Mind Shield, except is effective only against Essence spells.

sp-06869.description_en: As Protection I, except bonuses are 15.

sp-06870.description_en: As Mind Shield, except is effective only against Channeling spells.

sp-06871.description_en: As Mind Shield, except it is effective against any two of the three realms.

sp-06872.description_en: As Protection I, except bonuses are 25.

sp-06873.description_en: As Mind Shield, except is effective against all spells.

sp-06874.description_en: Gives a +50 to all RRs against all Mentalism spells.

sp-06875.description_en: As Mind Resistance, except is only effective against Essence spells.

sp-06876.description_en: As Mind Resistance, except is only effective against Channeling spells.

sp-06877.description_en: As Mind Resistance, except is effective against two of the three realms.

sp-06878.description_en: Condenses 1 cubic foot of water from the surrounding air. Water condenses gradually into caster hands and may be funneled into any suitable receptacle.

sp-06879.description_en: Warms 1 cu'/lvl of air (any inanimate gas) up to 100˚F above normal.

sp-06880.description_en: Creates dense fog in a 10'R; normal visibility is 1'. See Section 7.1.19.

sp-06881.description_en: Creates a 10'x10'x3' wall of dense churning air: cuts all movement and attacks through it by 50% (i.e., -50 to attacks).

sp-06882.description_en: Stops all generalized air movement (e.g., wind) up to winds of 30 mph and cuts higher winds by 30 mph in a 10'R.

sp-06883.description_en: Creates a 5'R near vacuum, all in radius take a 'A' Impact critical, as air leaves and rushes back in.

sp-06884.description_en: As Fog I, except radius is 50'.

sp-06885.description_en: All fog is dissipated in a 50'R.

sp-06886.description_en: As Airwall, except wall is 10'x20'x3' and can be curved up to a semicircle.

sp-06887.description_en: As Airwall, but has a set duration of 1 min/ lvl and doesn't require concentration.

sp-06888.description_en: As Fog I, except radius is 100'.

sp-06889.description_en: As Airstop I, except radius is 50'.

sp-06890.description_en: As Unfog V, except radius is 100'.

sp-06891.description_en: As Vacuum I, except radius is 10'.

sp-06892.description_en: All gas within 10'R of caster is converted to breathable air.

sp-06895.description_en: Creates a 50'R of high oxygen content air; all within receive a 20 bonus to their OBs and fire attacks deliver double damage.

sp-06896.description_en: As Fog I, except duration is 1 hr/lvl and radius is 100'/lvl.

sp-06898.description_en: Caster has complete control of clouds within area of effect (includes fog); he can control storm clouds and cause them to rain, but he can't create them.

sp-06908.description_en: All water within a 100'R is calmed. Waves are cut by 20' in the center of the area of effect (less towards the perimeter). This will negate the effects of currents in the area of effect.

sp-06909.description_en: As Waterwall, except has a set duration.

sp-06910.description_en: As Water Corridor I, except limit is 300'x4'x50' deep.

sp-06911.description_en: Creates a 20'R whirlpool that will draw in any unpowered objects up to 200' away. Powered objects may make a very hard movement manuever to resist the pull of the whirlpool.

sp-06912.description_en: Creates a wave moving away from the caster. Wave is 1' high per level at the center and 10' per level wide.

sp-06913.description_en: Creates a bubble of air (10'R) around the caster and others. The bubble will carry them in up to 100' of water (air is resuscitated). The caster must concentrate to move the bubble (without concentration it will simply rise to the surface). At the end of the duration, the bubble will begin to rise to the surface. All objects inside the bubble will rise with it. After reaching the surface, the bubble will burst.

sp-06914.description_en: As Calm Water, except radius is 100' per level and waves are cut by 50'.

sp-06915.description_en: As Water Corridor, except limit is 100' per level x 6' x 100' deep.

sp-06916.description_en: As Water Bubble, except radius is 20' and there is no depth limitation.

sp-06917.description_en: The caster can use one of the lower spells on this list each round, with a range of 10'/lvl.

sp-06899.description_en: Heats 1 cubic foot of liquid per level to boiling, at a rate of 50˚ per round of concentration. Caster is immune to the heat.

sp-06900.description_en: As Boil Water, except the liquid can be cooled until frozen.

sp-06901.description_en: As Boil Water, except that it clears liquid of all sediment.

sp-06902.description_en: As Boil Water, except that it removes all dissolved substances from the liquid.

sp-06903.description_en: Creates a 10'x10'x1' wall of churning water (a water source must be within 10'). All attacks through the wall suffer a -80 penalty. All movement through the wall is reduced by 80%.

sp-06904.description_en: As Boil Water, except all the liquid is evaporated at a rate of 1 cubic foot per round of concentration.

sp-06905.description_en: Creates a corridor through liquid up to 100' long, 3' wide, and 10' deep (must be open at the top).

sp-06906.description_en: A bolt of water is shot from the palm of the caster (a water source must be within 10'). Attack results are determined on the Water Bolt Attack Table.

sp-06907.description_en: As Waterwall, except wall is 10'x20'x1' and can be curved up to a semicircle.

sp-06918.description_en: Caster may cast this spell with any spell he wants to store. The spell to be stored must be cast within one minute after the Spell Store is cast. The stored spell may be cast later as an instantaneous spell. The Storing spell costs the same number of PPs as the spell stored. No other spell may be cast while a spell is stored.

sp-06919.description_en: Caster is aware of the presence of all sentient/ thinking beings within 20'.

sp-06920.description_en: Caster gets a +5 bonus to his RRs versus mind attacks.

sp-06921.description_en: Caster gets a 25% chance of recalling some key fact or occurrence that he has experienced. This information should relate to the current situation (could be from his background or something he has forgotten, GM's discretion). This spell gives the caster a +25 modification his Memory stat bonus for the duration of one maneuver (e.g., the use of a Lore skill, one hand of a card game, etc.).

sp-06922.description_en: For the purposes of mental or magical detections, the caster appears to be of any race he is familiar with.

sp-06923.description_en: Caster gains insight or facts by observing a person or thing with intense concentration. Gives the caster a +50 modification to his Perception skill bonus.

sp-06924.description_en: As Inner Wall I, except bonus is +10.

sp-06925.description_en: As Misfeel Kind, except caster's profession may appear to be of any profession that he is familiar with.

sp-06926.description_en: Caster is able to correlate known facts to obtain conclusions. This spell gives the caster a +25 modification to his Reasoning stat bonus for the duration of one maneuver (e.g., the use of a Lore skill, picking a lock, etc.).

sp-06927.description_en: As Misfeel Kind, except caster's level may appear to any level from 1 to double his current level.

sp-06928.description_en: Caster is able to intensely focus and control himself for one situation or maneuver. This spell gives the caster a +25 modification to his Self Discipline stat bonus for the duration of one maneuver (e.g., one meditation session, hiding from a foe, one “contortions” attempt, etc.).

sp-06929.description_en: As Inner Wall I, except bonus is +15.

sp-06930.description_en: As Misfeel Kind, except caster appears to have no presence (i.e., he cannot be detected by Presence spells).

sp-06931.description_en: As Inner Wall I, except bonus is +25.

sp-06932.description_en: As Recall, except recall is nearly automatic and, in effect, gives the caster a photographic memory. Memory stat bonus modification is +50.

sp-06933.description_en: Allows caster to use all of the “Misfeel” spells at once. Does not include the use of Unpresence.

sp-06934.description_en: As Inner Wall I, except bonus is +50.

sp-06935.description_en: As Observation, except virtually every detail in even a large situation is noticed. The bonus to a Perception skill bonus is +100.

sp-06936.description_en: As Correlation, except obtaining conclusions is nearly automatic. The Reasoning stat bonus modification is +50.

sp-06937.description_en: As Resolve, except focus/control is nearly total. The Self Discipline stat bonus modification is +50.

sp-06938.description_en: Caster reflects all mind attacks back on the attacker who must then make a RR against his own spell.

sp-06939.description_en: Caster “teleports” a single inanimate object to a point up to 100' away from its current location. There can be no intervening barriers in a direct line between the target and the point (for these purposes, a barrier is anything the object could not physically go through). The object has a maximum weight limit of 1 pound per level of the caster.

sp-06940.description_en: As Leave Item I, except the object can pass through barriers by specifying exact direction and distance. If the arrival point coincides with solid or liquid material, the object does not move (though the caster loses the PPs).

sp-06941.description_en: Caster “teleports” to a point up to 100' away, but there can be no intervening barriers directly between the target and the point (for these purposes a barrier is anything he could not physically go through; a closed door is a barrier, a pit is not).

sp-06942.description_en: As Leave Item I, except object can be moved up to 300'.

sp-06943.description_en: As Long Door Item I, except for range.

sp-06944.description_en: As Leaving I, except caster can move 300'.

sp-06945.description_en: As Leave Item I, except object can be moved up to 500'.

sp-06946.description_en: As Leaving, except caster can move 50' and he can pass through barriers by specifying exact direction and distance. If the arrival point coincides with solid or liquid material, the caster does not move. In addition, he is stunned d10 rounds, and the PPs for this spell are still expended.

sp-06947.description_en: As Leaving I, except caster can move 500'.

sp-06948.description_en: As Long Door, except caster can move 100'.

sp-06949.description_en: As Long Door Item I, except for range.

sp-06950.description_en: As Leaving, except caster can move 100' per level up to 2,000'.

sp-06951.description_en: As Long Door, except caster can move 300'.

sp-06952.description_en: As Long Door, except caster can move 500'.

sp-06953.description_en: If caster has established mental contact with a target (an intelligent being) that will cooperate, the caster can teleport to the target's location or the target can teleport to the caster's location. There is no chance of failure and the movement limit is 1 mile.

sp-06954.description_en: As Leaving, except movement is limited only by the barrier restriction (on a flat plain this would be the horizon).

sp-06955.description_en: As Mind's Door I, except limit is 10 miles per level.

sp-06956.description_en: As Mind's Door, except that there is no movement limit.

sp-06957.description_en: Allows caster to leap 50' laterally or 20' vertically.

sp-06958.description_en: Allows caster to land safely in a fall up to 20' per level, and to take that distance off the severity of any longer fall.

sp-06959.description_en: Allows caster to move up and down vertically 10' per round. The spell does not provide a means for horizontal movement.

sp-06960.description_en: Caster becomes weightless, but has no magical movement control. Weight gradually returns at the end of the duration.

sp-06961.description_en: Caster can take actions underwater as if on land.

sp-06962.description_en: As Levitation I, except caster can fly at a rate of 15' per round (i.e., 1 mph).

sp-06963.description_en: As Levitation I, except rate is 50' per round.

sp-06964.description_en: Caster can safely dive through the air up to 50' per level. At the end of the dive, the caster must land is water that is deep enough for the dive (at least 2' of water per 50' dived).

sp-06965.description_en: Caster can merge into any solid, inanimate material. While merged, the cster cannot move or perceive. When the caster emerges from the material, he can emerge from any side or face of the material. The caster cannot move “through” material greater in width than his own body size plus 2 feet. The caster can exit at any time up to 10 min/lvl.

sp-06966.description_en: As Fly I, except rate is 75' per round.

sp-06967.description_en: As Landing, except caster can land safely from any fall 99% of the time.

sp-06968.description_en: As Levitation I, except rate is 200' per round.

sp-06969.description_en: Caster can pass through any inanimate material up to 1' per level of the caster; it takes 1 round to pass through 2'.

sp-06970.description_en: As Fly I, except rate is 300'/rnd.

sp-06971.description_en: As Merging, except caster can turn within the material and can see outside if within 6" of the surface.

sp-06972.description_en: As Great Merge, except caster can cast spells on himself while merged.

sp-06973.description_en: As above, except rate is 400' per round.

sp-06974.description_en: As Passing, except caster can pass through as much material as the duration allows at a rate of 10' per round.

sp-06975.description_en: Caster may use the abilities of any one of the spells on this list each round.

sp-06976.description_en: Caster gains double normal hearing. This spell confers a +50 to Perception involving only hearing, +25 to Perception involving hearing and other senses.

sp-06977.description_en: Caster can see 100' on a clear night as if it were day. At least some small amount of residual light is required for this spell to work. See Section 7.1.19 for more on the environment's effect on vision.

sp-06978.description_en: Caster has a 300˚ field of vision. The flank bonus is reduced to +5 and the rear bonus is reduced to +15.

sp-06979.description_en: Caster can check one object or place (up to a 5'R) and tell if it is an illusion or has an illusion on it. See Section 7.1.27 for more on Illusions.

sp-06980.description_en: As Nightvision, except affects vision underwater (and other liquids).

sp-06981.description_en: Caster gains extremely acute sense of smell. This spell confers +50 to Perception involving only smell, +25 to Perception involving smell and other senses.

sp-06982.description_en: As Nightvision, except works in any precipitation or gas.

sp-06983.description_en: Caster gains extreme tactile sensitivity. This results in a bonus to all actions that require a sense of touch. For example, caster might receive +25 to picking locks, disarming traps, opening secret doors, etc. In addition, this spell confers a +50 to Perception involving only touch, +25 to Perception involving touch and other senses.

sp-06984.description_en: As Nightvision, except no light is required and caster can see even in magically created darkness.

sp-06985.description_en: Caster can pick a point up to 100' per level away and he will hear as if he were at that point (there can be intervening objects such as walls); he must have been at the location before or the location must be within his field of vision.

sp-06986.description_en: As Mentalist Ear, except caster can see instead of listening.

sp-06987.description_en: For the duration of the spell, one illusion within the area of effect ceases to exist (for the caster only). Caster must know that something is an illusion before this spell is cast.

sp-06988.description_en: As Detect Illusion, except caster can check one object or place per round.

sp-06989.description_en: As all lower level Vision spells functioning at the same time.

sp-06990.description_en: As Nightvision, except range is the range of normal daylight vision.

sp-06991.description_en: As Disillusion, except all illusions within range cease to exist for the caster. Caster need not be aware of any illusions within the range before casting this spell.

sp-06992.description_en: As Watervision, except range is the range of normal daylight vision.

sp-06993.description_en: As Fogvision, except range is the range normal daylight vision.

sp-06994.description_en: As all lower level Vision True spells functioning at the same time.

sp-06995.description_en: As Mentalist Ear, except range is 1 mile per level.

sp-06996.description_en: As Mentalist Eye, except range is 1 mile per level.

sp-06997.description_en: Caster can “merge” his senses with those of a subject whose exact location is known. Exact location can be established through a prior arrangement. If target of spell is not at the specified location, the PPs for this spell are still expended.

sp-06998.description_en: Adds +50 to any rolls for one slow moving maneuver (e.g., walking a 3" beam, etc.).

sp-06999.description_en: Allows caster to disjoint limbs, contract muscles, etc. to escape manacles/ropes and to slip through small places (+25 to +50 to Contortion maneuvers).

sp-07000.description_en: Allows caster to alter the form of his face. The caster may specify a specific person, but the change will not be exact.

sp-07001.description_en: For the duration, the caster can breathe water but not air.

sp-07002.description_en: Caster can alter his form to the form of any desired humanoid race. The form cannot be a specific form. For example, a human caster could take on the form of a Dwarf, but the Dwarven king. Only physical form is gained (e.g., the target who becomes a Dwarf would not receive the Dwarves' ability to see in the dark). The caster can only alter his size by up to 25%. See Section 7.1.11.

sp-07003.description_en: As Waterlungs, except caster can breathe any gas as normal air.

sp-07004.description_en: As Face Shifting, except lasts 1 hour per level.

sp-07005.description_en: As Waterlungs, except caster can breathe any air, water, and/or gas, at will.

sp-07006.description_en: As Change to Kind, except alteration can be to any organic form within 50% to 200% of the caster's current mass; does not confer any special abilities.

sp-07007.description_en: Caster becomes as if made of very dense stone (cannot move or cast spells).

sp-07008.description_en: As Change, except caster may assume a different form anytime during the spell. The change takes one round of concentration.

sp-07009.description_en: Caster takes the form of a liquid mass, able to seep through cracks as well as water. As a fluid, he can move through water at a rate of 10 mph. The caster may not cast spells while in this form.

sp-07010.description_en: Caster takes the form of a mist, able to fly at a rate of 20 mph. The caster may seep through cracks, extend himself to become virtually invisible, etc. The caster may not cast spells in this form.

sp-07011.description_en: As Waterform and Mistform, except the two forms are interchangeable at will. Changin from one form to another takes one round of concentration.

sp-07012.description_en: As Changing and Form Master, except all forms are interchangeable at will. Each change takes one round of concentration. The caster may vary his mass between 10% and 1000% of his own mass.

sp-07013.description_en: Warms 1 cubic foot of stone per level up to 100˚F at a rate of 1 cu' per round of concentration (without concentration, the material will remain at its current temperature for the remainder of the duration).

sp-07014.description_en: As Warm Stone, except 6 cubic inches of metal per level can be warmed each round.

sp-07015.description_en: As Warm Stone, except can affect any solid, inanimate, non-metal material.

sp-07016.description_en: As Warm Stone except temperature limit is 500˚F. In addition, caster must concentrate for 1 round to raise the temperature 50˚F (up to the maximum). Caster need only touch the target when the spell is cast.

sp-07017.description_en: As Heat Stone, except 6 cubic inches of metal per level can be heated.

sp-07018.description_en: As Heat Stone, except affects any solid, inanimate, non-metal material.

sp-07019.description_en: As Warm Stone, except chills any solid, inanimate material down to 0˚F.

sp-07020.description_en: As Heat Stone, except temperature can be lower to -200˚F at a rate of 100˚F per round.

sp-07021.description_en: Any previous cracks or flaws in material up to 10'x10'x10' section will extend to their limit.

sp-07022.description_en: As Heat Solid, except the only limit to the temperature is the melting point of the solid (i.e., until the solid melts). Will affect 6 cubic inches of metal or 1 cubic foot of any other material. See Section 7.1.13 for some sample melting points.

sp-07023.description_en: As Cracks Call, except material with cracks will crumble to dust.

sp-07024.description_en: Will break a piece of wood up to 1' in diameter.

sp-07026.description_en: As Stone Door, except doorway can be through metal.

sp-07027.description_en: As Bowbreak, except a piece of metal can be broken. Will affect metals up to 3" in diameter.

sp-07028.description_en: Causes a lock to break. The lock can be broken in a locked or unlocked state (regardless of its state at the time the spell is cast).

sp-07029.description_en: As Stone Door, except doorway can be in any inanimate, solid material and it can be 3'x6' with a depth of 1' per level (for stone) or 3" per level (for all other materials).

sp-07030.description_en: By molding with his hands, caster may shape 1 cubic foot of stone as if it were putty or clay. At the end of the spell's duration, the stone will harden to normal consistency.

sp-07031.description_en: As Mold Stone, except caster may mold metal.

sp-07032.description_en: As Mold Stone, except caster may mold any inanimate, solid material.

sp-07034.description_en: Caster may run (2x walking pace) without tiring (i.e., requires exhaustion points as if he were walking), but once he stops or performs any other action the spell is canceled.

sp-07036.description_en: For the duration of the spell, caster has 200% activity each round. Afterwards, the caster must spend as many rounds in rest (maximum of 50% activity) as he spent under the effects of Speed.

sp-07037.description_en: As Speed I, except duration is 2 rounds.

sp-07038.description_en: As Speed I, except no resting rounds are required.

sp-07039.description_en: As Speed I, except duration is three rounds.

sp-07040.description_en: As Run, except caster may move at 3x walking pace.

sp-07041.description_en: As Haste I, except duration is 2 rounds.

sp-07042.description_en: As Run, except caster swims double normal pace.

sp-07043.description_en: As Speed I, except duration is 5 rounds.

sp-07044.description_en: As Haste I, except duration is 3 rounds.

sp-07045.description_en: As Haste I, except duration is 5 rounds.

sp-07046.description_en: As Run, except caster may move at 4x walking pace.

sp-07047.description_en: As Speed I, except duration is 10 rounds.

sp-07048.description_en: As Haste I, except duration is 10 rounds.

sp-07049.description_en: As Speed I, except duration is until caster sleeps, rests, or cancels the spell (with a maximum duration of 8 hours).

sp-07050.description_en: As Haste I, except duration is until caster sleeps, rests, or cancels the spell (with a maximum duration of 8 hours).

sp-07051.description_en: Caster can move one object, up to 1 pound in mass, up to 1' per second (with no acceleration). If the caster stops concentration before the duration is up, the object remains stationary as if it had a Staying spell with an equal weight limit cast upon it.

sp-07052.description_en: Exerts 5 pounds of pressure on a person or object. Object cannot be moved by Staying alone and pressure can only be in one direction.

sp-07053.description_en: As Telekinesis I, except mass limit is 5 pounds.

sp-07054.description_en: As Staying II, except pressure limit is 25 pounds.

sp-07055.description_en: As Staying II, except 2 objects may be affected with 5 pounds total pressure or Staying II can be used to 200'.

sp-07056.description_en: As Telekinesis I, except 2 objects of 5 pounds total mass may be moved or Telekinesis I can be used at 200'.

sp-07057.description_en: As Telekinesis I, except mass limit is 25 pounds.

sp-07058.description_en: As Staying II, except pressure limit is 50 pounds.

sp-07059.description_en: As Telekinesis I, except mass limit is 50 pounds.

sp-07060.description_en: Caster may “hurl” one object (that starts within 10' of him) of 1 pound or less with sufficient force to deliver an attack on the Sling Attack Table with a maximum range of 300' (see Arms Law). The caster's OB will equal his directed spell skill with this spell. If Arms Law is not available, use the Shock Bolt Attack Table (with a maximum range of 300') with Impact Critical results.

sp-07061.description_en: As Staying II, except pressure limit is 100 pounds.

sp-07062.description_en: As Telekinesis I, except mass limit is 100 pounds.

sp-07063.description_en: As Hurling I, except mass limit is 5 pounds and it delivers double normal concussion hits.

sp-07064.description_en: As Staying II, except pressure limit is 200 pounds.

sp-07065.description_en: As Greater Staying II, except 3 objects may be affected with 25 pounds total pressure or Staying I can be used to 300'.

sp-07066.description_en: As Telekinesis I, except 3 objects of 25 pounds total mass may be moved or Telekinesis I can be used to 300'.

sp-07067.description_en: As Telekinesis I, except mass limit is 200 pounds.

sp-07068.description_en: As Hurling II, except limit is 25 pounds and delivers triple normal concussion hits.

sp-07070.description_en: As Telekinesis I, except mass limit is 20 pounds per level.

sp-07071.description_en: As Hurling I, except the object to be hurled may start up to 300' away or the caster may hurl 3 objects that start up to 100' away (at the same target).

sp-07072.description_en: As Hurling II, except limit is 50 pounds and it delivers four times normal concussion hits and the OB has an additional +50 bonus.

sp-07073.description_en: Each round, the caster may use any lower level spell on this list with a range of 300'.

sp-05265.description_en: Caster can stop bleeding on a wound that is bleeding up to 3 hits per round (total). Target may not be moved or bleeding will resume at prior rate.

sp-05266.description_en: Caster may stop bleeding on a wound that is bleeding 1 hit per round. For 1 hour, target can move at no more than a walking pace or bleeding will resume at prior rate.

sp-05267.description_en: Allows caster to stop bleeding from 1 wound that is bleeding at rate of 1 hit per round.

sp-05268.description_en: As Clotting I, except that caster can stop bleeding in a woud that is bleeding up to 3 hits per round (total).

sp-05269.description_en: Allows caster to completely mend a damaged minor blood vessel (a vessel that bleeds at up to 3 hits per round, not major arteries or veins).

sp-05270.description_en: As Cut Repair I, except that caster can repair wound(s) that bleed(s) for up to 3 hits per round (total); three 1 hit per round wounds or one 3 hits per round wound or one 2 hits per round and one 1 hit per round wound can be healed.

sp-05271.description_en: Caster can repair any one damaged vein. Target cannot move (under his own power) without reopening wound. Recovery time is 1-10 days.

sp-05272.description_en: Allows caster to repair any one damaged artery. Target cannot move (under his own power) without reopening wound. Recovery time is 1-10 days depending upon the size of the artery and the severity of the damage.

sp-05273.description_en: Allows caster to reattach 1 severed limb. Also requires the use of the other 3 Lay Healer Joining spells to make limb fully functional. Limb is fully functional after 10-100 days.

sp-05274.description_en: As Flowstop III, except that all blood loss (i.e., hits per round) from one wound is stopped.

sp-05275.description_en: Target is kept in a state of suspended animation and prevented from dying for the duration of this spell (i.e., the body is “preserved” and the “soul” will not leave the body). Also requires the use of the other Suspend Life I spell (on the Nerve and Organ Mastery spell list).

sp-05276.description_en: As Clotting I, except that all blood loss (i.e., hits per round) from one wound is stopped.

sp-05277.description_en: Allows caster to remove any one blood clot. Will counter Clotting Curse (on the Evil Cleric list, Curses). This spell has no affect on bleeding wounds that have clotted (i.e., “clots” in this sense apply only to internal blood clotting).

sp-05278.description_en: As Cut Repair I, except that it will stop bleeding and close any one wound.

sp-05279.description_en: As Suspend Life I, except for duration and the requirement of the other Suspend Life II spell (on the Nerve and Organ Mastery spell list).

sp-05280.description_en: As Unclotting, except will affect all blood clots in the target.

sp-05281.description_en: As Joining, except caster must cast the other 3 Lay Healer Joining True spells and the limb is fully functional in 10 minutes.

sp-05282.description_en: Allows caster to control all internal and external blood flow in the target. As long as the target remains immobile, bleeding can be halted until the wounds can be healed.

sp-05283.description_en: Allows caster to restore all the blood in any 1 target's body. Recovery time is 1-10 days.

sp-05284.description_en: Allows caster to cast one of the lower level spells on this list each round.

sp-05285.description_en: Caster acquires complete understanding of any bone damage, including the tools and methods required for healing. Caster does not receive the skill or power to perform the cure.

sp-05286.description_en: Allows caster to mend one simple fracture (not compound fracture, shatters, joint damage, etc.). Recovery time is 1 day. Will not work on skull fractures.

sp-05287.description_en: Allows caster to repair all the cartilage around one joint. Recovery time is one day.

sp-05289.description_en: Allows caster to prevent the deteriorization of 1 limb (even while severed). Requires the use of Limb Preservation from the Muscle Mastery spell list as well.

sp-05290.description_en: Allows caster to mend one fracture in a skull (but not a shattered areas). Recovery time is 1-10 days.

sp-05291.description_en: Allows caster to repair one broken (but not shattered) joint. Recovery time is 1-10 days.

sp-05293.description_en: Allows caster to reattach 1 severed limb. Also requires the use of the other 3 Lay Healer Joining spells to make limb fully functional. Limb is fully functional after 10-100 days.

sp-05294.description_en: As Cartilage Repair, except recovery is instantaneous.

sp-05296.description_en: As Skull Repair, except recovery is instantaneous.

sp-05297.description_en: Allows caster to transplant a healthy bone. This requires a 1 hour operation. Recovery time is 1-10 days. There is a chance that the target's body will reject the new bone: 10% if bone is from the same race as the target, 50% is the bone is from some other similiar race.

sp-05298.description_en: Allows caster to repair any 1 broken or shattered bone (even in the skull). This requires a 1 hour operation. Recovery time is 1-10 days.

sp-05299.description_en: As Joint Repair, except that recovery is instantaneous.

sp-05300.description_en: As Bone Transplant, except with a recovery time of 1-10 hours.

sp-05301.description_en: As Shatter Repair, except with a recovery time of 1-10 hours.

sp-05302.description_en: As Joining, except caster must cast the other 3 Lay Healer Joining True spells and the limb is fully functional in 10 minutes.

sp-05303.description_en: Allows caster to regenerate 1 section of cartilage in target's body. Recovery time is 1-10 days.

sp-05304.description_en: Allows caster to regenerate 1 lost bone. Recovery time is 1-10 days.

sp-05305.description_en: Allows caster to regenerate any part (or all) of a skeleton (including cartilage) in 1-10 days, depending on the severity of the damage.

sp-05306.description_en: Target is healed of d10 concussion hits.

sp-05307.description_en: Target is relieved of 1 round's worth of accumulated stun. See Section 7.1.1.

sp-05309.description_en: Will reduce damage target has by 1 hit every minute as long as the caster concentrates. If caster is unconscious this spell will operate without concentration. See Section 7.1.1 for more on unconscious spells.

sp-05311.description_en: As Frost/Burn Relief I, except heals 2 areas of mild damage or 1 area of moderate damage (e.g., 2nd degree burn).

sp-05312.description_en: As Healing I, except heals 5d10 hits.

sp-05313.description_en: As Stun Relief I, except 3 rounds of stun effects are relieved.

sp-05314.description_en: As Frost/Burn Relief I, except heals 3 areas of mild damage or 1 area of severe damage (e.g., 3rd degree burn) or combination of 1 mild and 1 moderate area.

sp-05315.description_en: As Regeneration I, except damage reduction is 2 hits per minute.

sp-05316.description_en: As Healing I, except heals 10d10 hits.

sp-05317.description_en: As Frost/Burn Relief I, except heals 4 mild or2 moderate or 1 mild and 1 severe or 2 mild and 1 moderate area(s) of damage.

sp-05318.description_en: As Stun Relief I, except target is relieved of 5 rounds of accumulated stun effects.

sp-05319.description_en: As Stun Relief I, except 1 target within 100' of caster is relieved of 1 round accumulated stun effects.

sp-05320.description_en: As Regeneration I, except damage reduction is 3 hits per minute.

sp-05322.description_en: As Stun Relief I, except target is relieved of 10 rounds of accumulated stun effects.

sp-05323.description_en: As Healing I, except heals 20d10 hits.

sp-05324.description_en: As Healing I, except target healed of all concussion hits.

sp-05325.description_en: As Frost/ Burn Relief I, except target relieved of all burns or frostbite.

sp-05326.description_en: As Stun Relief I, except target healed of all stun effects.

sp-05327.description_en: Allows caster to repair (not replace) one sprain. Requires a one hour operation.

sp-05328.description_en: Caster acquires complete understanding of any muscle and/or tendon damage, including the tools and methods required for healing. Caster does not receive the skill or power necessary to perform the cure.

sp-05329.description_en: Allows caster to repair 1 damaged muscle. Requires a 1 minute operation. Recovery time is 1 day per muscle repaired.

sp-05330.description_en: Allows caster to repair 1 damaged tendon. Requires a 1 minute operation. Recovery time is 1 day per tendon repaired.

sp-05331.description_en: Allows caster to prevent the deteriorization of 1 limb (even while severed). Requires the use of Limb Preservation from the Bone Mastery spell list as well.

sp-05332.description_en: As Muscle Repair I, except that caster can repair 3 damaged muscles.

sp-05333.description_en: As Tendon Repair I, except that caster can repair 3 damaged tendons.

sp-05334.description_en: As Muscle Repair, except recovery time is instantaneous.

sp-05335.description_en: Allows caster to reattach 1 severed limb. Also requires the use of the other 3 Lay Healer Joining spells to make limb fully functional. Limb is fully functional after 10-100 days.

sp-05336.description_en: As Tendon Repair, except recovery time is instantaneous.

sp-05337.description_en: Allows caster to repair all tendon and muscle damage in target's body. This requires a 1 hour operation. Recovery time is 1-10 days.

sp-05338.description_en: Allows caster to transplant a healthy muscle into the target. This requires a 1 hour operation. Recovery time is 1-10 days. There is a chance that the target's body will reject the new bone: 10% if bone is from the same race as the target, 50% is the bone is from some other similiar race.

sp-05339.description_en: Allows caster to regenerate 1 muscle. Regrowth takes 1-10 days, depending on extent of loss.

sp-05340.description_en: Allows caster to regenerate 1 tendon. Regrowth takes 1-10 days, depending on extent of loss.

sp-05341.description_en: lant — As Muscle Transplant, except recovery time is 1-10 hours.

sp-05342.description_en: eration — As Muscle Regeneration, except recovery time is 1-10 hours.

sp-05343.description_en: eration — As Tendon Regeneration, except recovery time is 1-10 hours.

sp-05348.description_en: Caster acquires complete understanding of any nerve and/or organ damage; including the tools and methods required for healing; caster does not receive the skill or power necessary to perform the cure.

sp-05349.description_en: Allows caster to stop or reduce feeling in a specific area of the body (2 cu" per level). Works to reduce pain with minor side effects (e.g., -10 to actions).

sp-05350.description_en: Allows caster to repair minor nerve damage. Recovery time is 1-10 days. Minor nerve damage is defined as any nerve damage that results in a penalty up to -20.

sp-05351.description_en: Allows caster to repair any exterior ear damage short of complete ear loss or any nose damage short of complete nose loss. Requires 1-60 minutes, depending on damage

sp-05352.description_en: Allows caster to prevent the deteriorization of any specific organ (e.g., eye, ear, liver), even if it is “outside” of its body.

sp-05353.description_en: Allows caster to repair any minor eye damage (e.g., corneal scratch or removal of foreign object).

sp-05354.description_en: As Minor Nerve Repair, except that caster can repair any nerve damage. Recovery time is 1-10 days.

sp-05355.description_en: As Minor Ear Repair, except caster can repair any interior or exterior damage. Hearing is restored in 110 days. Note that complete replacement of ear is an exception.

sp-05356.description_en: Allows caster to reattach 1 severed limb. Requires the use of the other 3 Lay Healer Joining spells to make limb fully functional. Limb is fully functional after 10-100 days.

sp-05357.description_en: As Minor Eye Repair, except caster can repair any eye damage short of total eye loss (i.e., eye's destruction precludes repair). Recovery time is 1-10 days.

sp-05358.description_en: Target is kept in a state of suspended animation and prevented from dying for the duration of this spell (i.e., the body is “preserved” and the “soul” will not leave the body). Also requires the use of the other Suspend Life I (on the Blood Mastery list).

sp-05359.description_en: As Major Nerve Repair, except that recovery is instantaneous.

sp-05360.description_en: Allows caster to transplant a healthy organ (not including brain or nervous system) into the target. Requires a 1 hour operation. Recovery time is 1-10 days. There is a chance that the target's body will reject the new bone: 10% if bone is from the same race as the target, 50% is the bone is from a similiar race. Will not transplant blood or muscles.

sp-05361.description_en: Allows caster to repair any organ (not brain or nervous system) that has not been completely destroyed. Requires a 1-10 hour operation. Recovery: 1-10 days.

sp-05362.description_en: Allows caster to repair minor brain damage (including recovery from coma). Lost experience is not restored (% lost permanently dependent on severity of damage). Requires a 1 hour operation. Recovery time is 1-10 days.

sp-05363.description_en: Allows caster to cure paralysis in 1 target (recovery time of 1-10 days). Paralysis must have resulted from a spell or disease (not a poison).

sp-05364.description_en: As Suspend Life I, except for duration and the requirement of the Suspend Life II spell (on the Blood Mastery spell list).

sp-05365.description_en: lant — As Organ Transplant, except recovery time is only 1-10 hours.

sp-05366.description_en: As Joining, except caster must cast the other 3 Lay Healer Joining True spells and the limb is fully functional in 10 minutes.

sp-05367.description_en: Allows caster to regenerate lost nerve. Regrowth takes 1-10 days, depending on extent of loss.

sp-05368.description_en: Allows caster to completely regenerate lost organ. This process takes 1-10 hours. Recovery time takes 1-10 days. The target remains in coma during recovery (this spell will not regenerate the brain).

sp-05369.description_en: Allows caster to regenerate brain tissue in 1-10 hours. Recovery time is 1-10 days (target is in coma during recovery). Note that lost experience is not restored (the % lost permanently depends on severity of damage).

sp-05370.description_en: Caster knows the proper dimesions need to make a false limb for the target.

sp-05371.description_en: Caster may mold target wood (up to 4 cubic feet) as if it were clay when he concentrates. It normally takes 1 day (approximately 8 hours) to mold an artificial limb. At the end of the molding time, the target wood returns its normal hardness.

sp-05372.description_en: Caster attaches a wooden (artificial) limb to a body. Process takes 1 hour. This spell must be cast before an Animation spell can be cast.

sp-05373.description_en: Allows wearer to operate an artificial limb at will for 8 hours.

sp-05374.description_en: As Mold Wood, except works on glass. The process takes 2 days (approximately 8 hours per day) hours to mold.

sp-05375.description_en: As Fit Wood; except allows caster to fit a glass limb.

sp-05376.description_en: As Animation I, except duration is 24 hours.

sp-05377.description_en: As Mold Wood, except involves basic metals and the process takes 4 days (approximately 8 hours per day).

sp-05378.description_en: As Fit Wood; allows caster to fit a normal metal limb.

sp-05379.description_en: This spell enables caster to convert clay into enough artificial flesh to cover one artificial limb (limb must be present at the time of casting). The flesh is only semirealistic (similiar to plastic). The process takes 2 days (approximately 8 hours each day), but might require more for larger limbs (GM's discretion).

sp-05380.description_en: As Animation I, except duration is 1 week.

sp-05381.description_en: As Fit Wood; except allows caster to fit limbs of enchanted materials (the limb must be created through some other means).

sp-05382.description_en: As Animation I, except duration is 1 month.

sp-05383.description_en: As Animation I, except duration is 3 months.

sp-05384.description_en: As Animation I, except duration is 6 months.

sp-05385.description_en: As Artificial Flesh, except perfectly realistic synthetic flesh can be made and worked. This process takes 10-100 days, depending on amount of flesh needed.

sp-05388.description_en: As Animation, except duration is permanent.

sp-05390.description_en: Target hesitates in any nondefensive action. He suffers a -20 to initiative rolls and he must parry with at least half of his OB.

sp-05391.description_en: Target takes 25% of his remaining concussion hits (i.e., those not already taken).

sp-05392.description_en: Target takes an 'A' Electricity critical strike.

sp-05393.description_en: As Jolts I, except for duration.

sp-05395.description_en: As Shock A, except Electricity critical is a 'B'.

sp-05396.description_en: As Minor Pain, except 50% of remaining concussion hits are taken.

sp-05397.description_en: Everyone within the area of effect is a target, all failing to resist are stunned.

sp-05398.description_en: As Jolts I, except for duration.

sp-05399.description_en: As Paralyze I, except duration is 3 rounds per 10 failure.

sp-05400.description_en: As Shock A, except Electricity critical is a 'C'.

sp-05401.description_en: As Mind Shout I, except area of effect is 50'R.

sp-05402.description_en: As Shock A, except Electricity critical is a 'D'.

sp-05403.description_en: As Paralyze I, except duration is 5 rounds per 10 failure.

sp-05404.description_en: As Jolts I, except for duration.

sp-05405.description_en: As Mind Shout I, except area of efect is 100'R.

sp-05406.description_en: As Shock A, except Electricity critical is an 'E'.

sp-05407.description_en: As Mind Shout I, except area of effect is 50'R and any target failing by more than 50 is unconscious for eight hours.

sp-05408.description_en: As Mind Shout I, except area of effect is 300'R.

sp-05409.description_en: As Mind Shout (50'R), except targets failing by 1-50 are unconscious, and targets failing by more than 50 are dead. RRs for Mentalism spell users are modified by -20.

sp-05410.description_en: Target must answer a single-concept question truthfully (though he must be able to understand the question).

sp-05411.description_en: Target falls into natural sleep. The first round is a magical sleep (the target cannot be awakened through normal means).

sp-05412.description_en: Humanoid target believes caster is a good friend.

sp-05413.description_en: Target will take no offensive action, will fight only in self-defense.

sp-05414.description_en: Target is incapable of making decisions or initiating action; may continue to fight current foes or in self-defense.

sp-05415.description_en: Target fears caster and attempts to flee. Fleeing usually equates to running at maximum pace away from the caster.

sp-05416.description_en: Target will follow a single suggested act that was not completely alien to him (e.g., no suicide suggestions, no blinding himself suggestions, etc.).

sp-05417.description_en: Target is held to 25% of normal action.

sp-05418.description_en: Causes any desired emotion. Possible emotions include hate, love, sadness, anger, etc.

sp-05419.description_en: Target must obey the caster as specified in Suggestion.

sp-05420.description_en: [RR Mod: +20] Target falls into a coma.

sp-05421.description_en: As Charm Kind, except works on any sentient creature.

sp-05422.description_en: As Hold Kind, except any sentient being can be affected.

sp-05423.description_en: Target is given 1 task. Failure results in a penalty determined by GM (task must be within target's capabilities). If the target ignores the task, he will suffer the same effects of failure.

sp-05424.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] Target is totally paralyzed (0% action).

sp-05425.description_en: Target is a blathering idiot. He may be led around but he can take no action.

sp-05426.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] Target is unconscious and unwakeable.

sp-05427.description_en: As Geas, except failure is punished by the target suffering five 'E' criticals (choose which critical types randomly).

sp-05428.description_en: When he concentrates, caster has total control of target's mind. After the initial casting, the range for control is 1 mile per level of the caster.

sp-05429.description_en: As Mind Control True, except duration is permanent (until dispelled). The caster need only concentrate to give commands. Only one target can be controlled in this fashion at a time.

sp-05430.description_en: Caster learns target's basic feelings. The caster can concentrate on a new target each round.

sp-05431.description_en: Caster learns target's emotions in detail. The caster can concentrate on a new target each round.

sp-05434.description_en: Caster receives surface thoughts from target. If target makes his RR by more than 25 he realizes that someone is trying to read his thoughts.. The caster can concentrate on a new target each round.

sp-05435.description_en: Allows caster and target to interchange thoughts; if both are Mentalism spell users they can interchange power points. They must be able to see each other or the caster must know the exact location of the target or the caster must use Focus Merge to locate the target (in all cases, the target must be within range).

sp-05436.description_en: The caster prepares himself to be the target of a Mind Merge or Ready Merge spell, thus, increases the range of the “incoming” spell. The increased range is equal to the original range times the number of Power Points used to cast the Prepare Merge spell (e.g., if a caster uses 18 Power Points, the range is 18x normal).

sp-05437.description_en: As Mind Merge I, except range is 100'.

sp-05438.description_en: As in Thoughts, except caster also learns reasoning and thought patterns behind surface thoughts.

sp-05439.description_en: As in Mind Merge I, except for range and caster and target must have Merged before and it is instantaneous.

sp-05440.description_en: Target and caster switch minds and spell casting abilities. Target (in caster's body) is in a coma if he is not also a Mentalist. If the target is unwilling, he may make a new RR every hour.

sp-05441.description_en: As in Inner Thoughts, except caster can also scan target's conscious memories, at a rate of 1 scene every round.

sp-05442.description_en: As Mind Merge I, except for range and caster must know the exact location of the target mentally or through some other means.

sp-05443.description_en: As in Mind Scan, except caster can probe target's subconscious memories (i.e., all experiences).

sp-05444.description_en: As in Mind Switch, except lasts until the caster decides to return to his own body.

sp-05445.description_en: Caster can remove one thought or memory from the target's mind each round.

sp-05446.description_en: As in Ready Merge, except range is unlimited.

sp-05447.description_en: Caster may mentally speak with another spell caster of the Mentalism realm.

sp-05448.description_en: The caster enters a trance-like state to prepare his mind to be the recipient for a Mind Tongue spell. While he is under the effects of this spell, any “incoming” Mind Tongue spell has its range increased by 10 times.

sp-05449.description_en: Caster may mentally speak with any one thinking being. They must be able to see each other or the caster must know the exact location of the target or the caster must use Focus Merge to locate the target (in all cases, the target must be within range).

sp-05450.description_en: When this spell is cast, the next Mind Tongue spell (cast within one minute of this spell) will be able to focus in on a specific person as its target. The person must be Mind Stored (see the Presence spell list).

sp-05451.description_en: As Prepare Mind I, except range is increased by 20 times.

sp-05452.description_en: As Mind Tongue I, except range is 500'.

sp-05453.description_en: As Prepare Mind I, except range is increased by 50 times.

sp-05454.description_en: Caster can broadcast thoughts to minds of all within range. This is a “one-way” communication.

sp-05455.description_en: As Mind Tongue I, except range is 1,000'.

sp-05456.description_en: As Prepare Mind I, except range is increased by 100 times.

sp-05457.description_en: As Mind Speech I, except area of effect is 100'R.

sp-05458.description_en: As Mind Speech, except caster can limit broadcast to desired beings.

sp-05459.description_en: As Prepare Mind I, except range is increased by 500 times.

sp-05460.description_en: As Mind Speech I, except area of effect is 300'R.

sp-05461.description_en: A 25-word mental message can be delayed. The triggering area must be no larger than 10'R and the trigger can be any of the following: a fixed time period up to 24 hours, specified movements, specified sounds, touch, reading, or by a specific Mind Stored person entering the area.

sp-05462.description_en: As Prepare Mind I, except range is increased by 1,000 times.

sp-05463.description_en: As Mind Tongue I, except range is 1 mile.

sp-05465.description_en: As Mind Speech I, except area of effect is 2,000'R.

sp-05466.description_en: As Mind Tongue I, except range is 1 mile per level.

sp-05467.description_en: As Waiting Tongue, except it is broadcast to all within a 300'R.

sp-05468.description_en: As Mind Speech I, except area of effect can be up to 1 mile per level from caster.

sp-05469.description_en: Caster is aware of the presence of all sentient/ thinking beings within his range.

sp-05470.description_en: Caster gets general idea of the race and level of one being. The target must first be located by Presence or Presence True.

sp-05471.description_en: As Feel I, except caster stores mental pattern of target. This can be used with other spells (both on this list and others). The caster can only have as many patterns stored as the sum of his Memory and Presense temporary stats (not the bonuses). The caster can choose to release a stored pattern at any given time (the GM should require that a character keep track of all the patterns he has stored).

sp-05472.description_en: The caster can transfer a copy of any one Mind Stored person to another caster from the Mentalism realm (i.e., both casters now have the person stored). The target of this spell must know the Mind Store spell.

sp-05473.description_en: As Feel I, except analyzes 3 targets at once (all targets must be within range).

sp-05474.description_en: As Feel I, except caster learns race, profession, and level of target.

sp-05475.description_en: Caster gets direction and distance to any unshielded mind that he has a mental pattern of (from Mind Store).

sp-05476.description_en: Caster gets direction to any unshielded mind which he has a mental pattern of (from Mind Store).

sp-05477.description_en: Can get presences in one 50'R. The caster can concentrate on one 50'R area each round.

sp-05478.description_en: As Presence, plus a general knowledge of the target's actions. In a tactical situation, the caster can declare his actions after learning one of the target's actions for the round (and when he wants to perform the action). This does not prevent the target from changing his action (with the appropriate penalty for changing his action).

sp-05479.description_en: As above, except range is 1 mile per level.

sp-05480.description_en: As Feel I, except that range is 100' per level.

sp-05481.description_en: As Feel I, except analyzes 5 targets at once (all targets must be within range).

sp-05482.description_en: As Feel I, except caster may “feel” one target per round.

sp-05483.description_en: As Mind Typing, except range is 100' per level.

sp-05484.description_en: As Finding I, except range is 1 mile per level.

sp-05485.description_en: As Feel I, except analyzes 10 targets at once (all targets must be within range).

sp-05486.description_en: As Awareness, except that caster learns all actions of the target.

sp-05487.description_en: As Finding I, except range is 5 miles per level.

sp-05488.description_en: As Direction I, except no range limitations.

sp-05489.description_en: As Finding I, except no range limitations.

sp-05490.description_en: Target suffers a -30 modification to all actions.

sp-05491.description_en: Random limb of target's is numb and useless. If the limb is a leg, the target loses 40% of his movement. If the limb is an arm, the target suffers -40 to melee and missile fire with that arm.

sp-05492.description_en: Target has a -100 OB modification for missile attacks and -50 for all other actions.

sp-05493.description_en: Causes minor, false sensations in any one of: smell, taste, or touch (e.g., an itch, a stinky smell, or a salty taste).

sp-05495.description_en: Causes target to hear any sound(s) desired.
