sp-05725.description_en: As Vision Behind I, except time range is 1 year per level.

sp-05734.description_en: Caster can see through the eyes of any nonintelligent animal in range. The animal must be seen or located via Presence or located via Mind Store & Finding (for the initial contact only).

sp-05736.description_en: As Animal Sight, except all of the animal's senses can be used.

sp-05739.description_en: As Animal Sight I, except the range is 300'.

sp-05741.description_en: As Animal Sense I, except the range is 300'.

sp-05743.description_en: As Sight Merge I, except the range is 300'.

sp-05744.description_en: As Animal Sight I, except the range is 500'.

sp-05745.description_en: As Sight Merge I, except all of the being's senses can be used.

sp-05746.description_en: As Animal Sense I, except the range is 500'.

sp-05748.description_en: As Sight Merge I, except the range is 500'.

sp-05756.description_en: As Sensory Merge I, except the range is unlimited.

sp-05642.description_en: Caster can see through 10' per level of water (even murky water) as if it were day. Some residual light must exist for this spell to work.

sp-05643.description_en: As Watersight, except caster can see in normal darkness such as a clear night outdoors. Some residual light (e.g., starlight, phosphorescent fungus) must exist for this spell to work.

sp-05644.description_en: As Watersight, except caster can see in fog, mist, any other precipitation or any gas.

sp-05645.description_en: Caster can see through non-magical wood (up to 1" thickness per level of experience).

sp-05646.description_en: Caster's point of hearing may be moved independently away (up to 10' per level of experience) at a rate of 10' per round. He must physically be able to go there (e.g., he could not send his hearing through walls or closed doors).

sp-05647.description_en: Caster can pick a point (up to 10' away), and he will be able to see and/or hear from that point. The point is fixed but can be rotated. There can be intervening barriers such as walls.

sp-05648.description_en: Caster's point of sight may be moved independently away (up to 10' per level of experience) at a rate of 10' per round. The point of sight may also be rotated. He must physically be able to go there (e.g., he could not send his sight through walls or closed doors).

sp-05649.description_en: Caster can see all invisible beings or objects as if they were not invisible. Note that this means the invisible object is not “detected;” it simply isn't invisible to the caster.

sp-05650.description_en: As Woodsight II, except caster can see through any non-magical stone.

sp-05651.description_en: As Woodsight II, except caster can see through any non-magical iron or steel.

sp-05652.description_en: Caster can see “through” all visual illusions, phantasms, and glamours.

sp-05653.description_en: As Observe I, except for the range.

sp-05654.description_en: As Long Ear, except for the range and the caster may move any and all senses.

sp-05655.description_en: As Ironsight II, except caster may see through any non-magical metal.

sp-05656.description_en: As Nightsight, except caster can see through magically created darkness (such as those resulting from Dark or Utterdark spells) or total ordinary darkness (i.e., no residual light required).

sp-05657.description_en: As Observe I, except 2 points up to 100' away may be observed simultaneously.

sp-05658.description_en: As Observe I, except for the range.

sp-05659.description_en: As Woodsight, except caster can see through any non-magical wall of any thickness.

sp-05660.description_en: As Observe III, except caster does not have to concentrate until the spell is triggered by some movement or some sound which could be perceived from the observation point (and after the spell “activates,” the caster must concentrate on the point or the spell will be dispelled). If the caster is ever more than 100' per level of experience of the point selected, the spell is dispelled.

sp-05661.description_en: As Long Sense, except for the range.

sp-05662.description_en: As Observe III, except for the duration and the caster need not concentrate (he need only glance and listen once every three rounds).

sp-05663.description_en: As Woodsight II, except the caster can see through all inanimate material. Highly magical materials might receive an RR (at the GM's discretion).

sp-05664.description_en: As Long Sense, except the caster may move his senses with no limitations on range.

sp-05666.description_en: Caster can detect whether an unfulfilled fate, destiny, or wyrd lies upon a person, object, or place.

sp-05668.description_en: The caster can attempt to avoid one attack, which can be a missile or a melee attack or a spell. The missile, weapon, or enemy spellcaster must be within range and within the caster's field of vision when this spell is cast. The caster receives a bonus of +50 to his DB against missile, melee, and directed elemental attacks; his normal DB against area elemental attacks, or the enemy spellcaster suffers a -10 to his Base Attack Roll (for all other spell attacks).

sp-05670.description_en: Caster has a dream relating to a topic decided upon just before retiring. This spell can only be used once per night, the caster must sleep a minimum of one sleep cycle, and the caster must not be disturbed during the sleep.

sp-05671.description_en: Predicts most probable action of a being in the next round; specifics are not learned (e.g., attack in melee, cast a spell; but no details on targets or exactly what spell) This results in the caster being able to declare his statement of intent for the round after hearing what the target has decided to do. Note the target is free to change his declared action (with the requisite penalties).

sp-05672.description_en: The caster is able (using the culturally specific apparatus) to make a prediction concerning a person, place, or object. Using the apparatus to make the prediction will take at least one minute per level of the spell. Only one prediction may be made in any given 24-hour period by the caster (and a failed spell counts towards this limit). The prediction will be accurate 25% of the time plus 1% per level of the caster (otherwise, the results are random). The prediction may not concern events further than one day per level of the caster into the future. The predictions will be general, ambiguous and enigmatic. The interpretation of the predictions is left entirely to the caster.

sp-05673.description_en: As Anticipations I, except if the action is to cast a spell, the exact spell to be cast and the target are learned.

sp-05675.description_en: As Dream I, except limit is 2 dreams per night on different topics.

sp-05676.description_en: As Divinations I, except the prediction may concern events up to 1 month per level of the caster into the future.

sp-05678.description_en: This provides an analysis of an unfulfilled destiny in terms of who made the prophecy and/or the source of the destiny, the strength of the destiny, and where appropriate the oracular riddle (or whatever) which encapsulates the destiny. The spell does not indicate how a destiny may be fulfilled. Note that this spell will reveal if a given prophecy or divination is a hoax—the strength of the destiny will in such cases depend on the degree to which the victim of the hoax believes in the divination.

sp-05680.description_en: As Dream I, except limit is 3 dreams per night on different topics.

sp-05681.description_en: As Divinations III, except the predictions may concern events up to 1 year per level of the caster into the future.

sp-05682.description_en: As Anticipations III, except if any of the actions involve spell casting, the spells to be cast and the targets are learned.

sp-05683.description_en: As Anticipations V, except caster can either predict the most probable actions of 5 beings in the next round or can predict the most probable actions of one being over the next five rounds.

sp-05684.description_en: As Dream I, except limit is 5 dreams per night on any combination of topics.

sp-05685.description_en: As Anticipations I, except caster can predict the most probable actions of every being within 100'.

sp-05686.description_en: As Anticipations True, except if the actions are to cast spells, the spells to be cast and intended targets are learned.

sp-05687.description_en: As Divinations I, except the prediction may concern events up to ten years per level of the caster into the future.

sp-05688.description_en: Caster is aware of the presence of all thinking/sentient beings within his range. The caster may opt to use this spell to become aware of animal presences within his range (for use with spells on the Vision Borrowing spell list). If the caster wishes to sense animal presences, he must expend one PP in the casting of this spell.

sp-05689.description_en: Caster stores the mental pattern of a target which must first have been detected by Presence. This pattern can be used with other spells on this list (and other lists). The caster can only have as many patterns stored as the sum of his Memory and Presence stats (not the bonuses). The caster can choose to release a pattern at any given time (the GM should require that a character keep track of all the patterns he has stored).

sp-05690.description_en: Caster learns one of the following concerning a target: race, profession, or level. The target must have been located by Presence.

sp-05691.description_en: Caster learns direction and distance to any unshielded mind for which he has a mental pattern from Mind Store or Long Mind Store, and which is within range of this spell.

sp-05692.description_en: Caster receives surface thoughts from the target. If target makes his RR by more than 25 he realizes that someone is trying to read his thoughts. The caster can concentrate on a new target each round.

sp-05693.description_en: Target must answer single-concept questions truthfully. Questions are asked and answered mentally. One question may be asked per round.

sp-05694.description_en: As Analysis, except caster learns race, profession, and level of the target.

sp-05695.description_en: As Presence, the caster also gains general knowledge of all of the targets' actions. In a tactical situation, the caster can declare his actions after learning one of each of the targets' actions for the round (and when he wants to perform the action). This does not prevent the target from changing his action (with the appropriate penalty for changing his action).

sp-05696.description_en: The caster knows when anyone within the radius is lying.

sp-05697.description_en: As Thoughts, except caster also learns reasoning and thought patterns behind surface thoughts.

sp-05698.description_en: As Awareness, except that the caster learns all actions for the round.

sp-05699.description_en: As Mind Store, except for the range.

sp-05700.description_en: As Mind Typing, except for the range.

sp-05701.description_en: As Minor Finding, except for the range.

sp-05702.description_en: As Inner Thoughts, except caster can also scan the target's conscious memories at a rate of one scene every round.

sp-05703.description_en: As Truth I, except for the area of effect.

sp-05704.description_en: As Truth I, except for the range.

sp-05705.description_en: As Truth I, except when this spell is cast before any Vision Behind spell, it will detect anyone who is lying within the vision.

sp-05706.description_en: As Minor Finding, except for the range.

sp-05707.description_en: As Mind Scan, except caster can probe target's subconscious memories (i.e., all experiences).

sp-05708.description_en: Caster can remove one thought or memory from the target's mind each round.

sp-05709.description_en: This can either be cast as Truth V with a duration of one minute per level or as Long Truth with a range of 100' per level.

sp-05710.description_en: As Minor Finding, except for the range.

sp-05718.description_en: When cast before a Vision Behind spell, this allows the caster to perceive the past using one (and only one) additional sense (i.e., smell, taste, feel) or to use one and only one perceptive skill (in addition to the normal vision and hearing; such as Power Perception or Reality Awareness).

sp-05722.description_en: As Item Vision, except gives a vision of a significant event in the past which occurred at the caster's current location.

sp-05726.description_en: Gives a complete rundown on an item's construction, powers and purpose (completeness or specificity of information may be reduced if the item is extremely powerful).

sp-05727.description_en: As Vision Behind I, except time range is up to 1 year per level of the caster (with an accuracy of ±1 week) and the trance can last up to 5 hours per level of the caster.

sp-05728.description_en: As Item Vision, except gives a vision of a significant event which happened in the target's past.

sp-05729.description_en: By using an appropriate reflecting medium (e.g., a pool, crystal ball, or mirror), the caster may cast this spell before casting a Vision Behind spell to cause the vision to appear in the medium. Persons other than the caster will only receive the visual aspects of the vision. Each person other than the caster will continue to share the vision until either they stop concentrating, the caster stops concentrating, or the trance ends.

sp-05730.description_en: If the caster has general information concerning an event in the past of a person, place, or object, casting this spell before a Vision Behind spell will cause the Vision Behind spell to key in on the event most closely matching the description. The more accurate and specific the description, the more accurate this spell will be.

sp-05731.description_en: As Vision Behind I, except time range is up to 10 years per level of the caster (with an accuracy of ±1 month) and the trance can last up to 10 hours per level of the caster.

sp-05732.description_en: As Vision Behind VII, except time range is up to 100 years per level of the caster (with an accuracy of ±1 year), and the trance can last up to 1 day per level of the caster.

sp-05733.description_en: As Vision Behind VII, except time range is unlimited (with an accuracy of ±10 years), and the trance can last up to 1 day per level of the caster. Time passes at a rate of 1 minute of real time for each hour of the vision.

sp-05735.description_en: As Animal Sight I, except auditory sense is borrowed.

sp-05737.description_en: As Animal Sight I, except any being's visual sense may be borrowed.

sp-05738.description_en: As Animal Hearing I, except any being's auditory sense may be borrowed.

sp-05740.description_en: The caster may view a person, item, or location, seeing what is happening at that very moment at the “scried” site. The caster must be able to name the person or location uniquely (or describe the location, person, or item uniquely). The caster must concentrate upon some medium. The scried target will appear in the medium. If the medium is mobile (e.g., a crystal ball, a mirror), the range to the scried target is limited to 100' per level of the caster. If the medium is immobile (e.g., a pool), the range is limited to 1000' per level of the caster. The caster may only see what is happening at the scried site (no other senses are given) and may only use his normal visual faculties (no enhancements such as Nightsight or Woodsight are permitted). Unless the spell Scrying Share is used, only the caster will be able to see the vision in the medium (others who can see the medium will see nothing) Persons at a scried site may make a Power Perception maneuver (with a Hard difficulty) to notice that they are being scried (though only educated persons will know the cause of this feeling).

sp-05747.description_en: As Scrying I, except the range limitation is 1 mile per level of the caster for a mobile medium and 10 miles per level for an immobile medium.

sp-05749.description_en: As Animal Sight I, except for the range.

sp-05750.description_en: By casting this on targets (up to a maximum of 1 target per level of the caster) prior to casting a Scrying spell, the targets will be able to see what the scryer sees while the Scrying spell is active (and the target(s) remain concentrating). The same caveats that apply to the scryer apply to all who share the scrying. Note that the size of the medium may practically limit the number of targets that can view the medium while the spell is active.

sp-05751.description_en: As Sensory Merge I, except for the range.

sp-05752.description_en: As Animal Sense I, except for the range.

sp-05753.description_en: As Sight Merge I, except for the range.

sp-05754.description_en: As Sensory Merge, except for the range.

sp-05755.description_en: As Scrying I, except range is limited to 10 miles per level of the caster for a mobile medium and 100 miles per level of the caster for an immobile medium.

sp-05757.description_en: Detects if a being, item, or place in the area of effect is currently being scried upon. The caster may concentrate on a different 5'R each round.

sp-05758.description_en: Detects if an attempt is being made to divine the future of a being, item, or place in the area of effect. The caster may concentrate on a different 5'R each round.

sp-05759.description_en: Allows the caster to cloud the scrying of a specific subject touched by the caster at the time of casting this spell. If this spell is successful, the scryer perceives his vision as if through a fog, gaining only 50% of the knowledge that he would have gained if unimpeded. This protection lasts until the duration runs out, the spell is cancelled (or dispelled), or the defense is pierced by a scryer (whichever happens first).

sp-05760.description_en: Allows the caster to conceal one curse or destiny which lies upon the subject, rendering the curse or destiny undetectable by Detect Curse or Detect Destiny. The curse or destiny is still fully active, merely hidden to magical detections.

sp-05761.description_en: Allows the caster to protect the chosen subject (touched at time of casting), by if successful causing the scrying to go awry and lock onto a very similar subject (the similar subject must be within 10' per level of the caster at the time of the casting of this spell). The decoy subject will appear so similar that the scryer must make a successful Altertness maneuver to realize his mistake. If no suitable decoy exists, this spell will fail.

sp-05762.description_en: All deeds performed by the target (while this spell is active) are “shadowed” to appropriate spells. For the purposes of appropriate spells (e.g., Death's Memory or Vision Behind), the information gained about the target will be shrouded in shadows.

sp-05763.description_en: For the duration of this spell, if the target successfully resists any “information-gathering” or “mind-reading” spells, he may portray falsehoods as truths. If the caster of the mindreading spell is aware by other means that the target must be deceiving him, or if the False Truth spell duration ends before the mind-reading spell's duration, the deception will be apparent.

sp-05764.description_en: This spell enables the target to mislead the caster of any Anticipate or Anticipations spell. In the case of Anticipations spells, the caster receives incorrect information with regard to the target's intended actions. In the case of Anticipate Blow, Anticipate Missile, Anticipate Spell, and Anticipate Attack, the caster of these spells receives no benefit from casting these spells (though the spells will be cast successfully, the benefit is negated by negative penalties applied to the positive bonuses).

sp-05765.description_en: The caster may set a false vision upon the chosen subject for “would-be” scryers to discover. The false vision must be fairly simple and may not portray scenes or events longer than the duration of this spell. This spell can be defeated by piercing or by repeated scrying (i.e., out-lasting the duration of this spell), or noting that something unlikely is occurring, or noting that events in the scrying repeat themselves exactly.

sp-05766.description_en: As Cloud Scrying, except the caster can cloud any form of divinatory magic upon the subject.

sp-05767.description_en: Once learned, this spell allows the caster to know when any scrying attempt is made upon him.

sp-05768.description_en: s—As Feel Scrying, except allows the caster to know when an attempt to divine information about him is made.

sp-05769.description_en: As Shadow Past, except absolutely no information about the target will be revealed. For example, a Death's Memory cast on the scene of a murder might show the victim collapsing with a knife in his chest (but no sign of the knifewielder). The shrouding may be pierced, otherwise it is permanent.

sp-05770.description_en: Any attempt to divine information about the protected subject (touched at time of casting) will receive a false reading, with the elements of the reading specified by the caster at time of casting.

sp-05771.description_en: The target of this spell appears to have no presence for the duration of this spell, and so may not be detected by Presence-type spells.

sp-05772.description_en: The caster may use this spell to determine the location and identity of a scryer whose activities have been detected by either Detect Scrying, Feel Scrying, or Power Perception.

sp-05773.description_en: As Scrying Analysis, except determines the location and identity of a diviner whose activities have been detected by either Detect Divinations, Feel Divinations, or Power Perception.

sp-05774.description_en: As Shadow Past, except all deeds performed by the target (while this spell is active) will appear as if someone else is performing them. The false actor is chosen by the caster at the time of casting and the effectiveness of the falsification will depend on how well the caster can visualize the intended “fall guy.” Merely observing someone is not as good as any of the following spells: Study Pasty, Impersonation Study, or Change Lore.

sp-05775.description_en: The caster may use this spell to conceal the memories of the target from Inner Thoughts, Mind Scan, and Mind Probe spells etc. The caster may hide memories at a rate of one scene per round (with a maximum number of rounds equal to the caster's level). The hidden memories are still available to the target.

sp-05776.description_en: As Conceal Memories, except the caster may replace real memories with false memories at a rate of one memory per round. The target has access to both the true and the false memories.

sp-05777.description_en: The subject of this spell is protected from all divinatory magic for the duration of the spell. This spell lasts until it is cancelled, dispelled, or the duration runs out (whichever is sooner), and may not be pierced. Any divinatory magic attempted upon the subject will simply fail, and any divinatory magic attempted upon other subjects where the protected subject may directly or indirectly significantly effect the future of the protected subject will provide answers which do not take the possible actions of the protected subject into account. However the protected subject may not use divinatory magic of any sort upon himself or other subjects for the duration of this spell. The subject is truly outside the weave of fate.

sp-06429.description_en: Creates an invisible force shield in front of the caster. This functions as a normal shield (subtracting 25 from appropriate attacks, etc) except it does not occupy a hand. This spell cannot be combined with a “real” (i.e., physical) shield.

sp-06430.description_en: Causes target to appear blurred to attackers. This subtracts 10 from all attacks.

sp-06431.description_en: Caster enchants a suit of armor which is to become his “Personal Armor.” This spell reduces the Minimum Maneuver Penalty, the Maximum Maneuver Penalty, the Missile Attack Penalty, and the Quickness Penalty of the armor by 1 per level of the caster (at the time of casting the spell). If the caster gains in level, and he wishes to reduce the penalties (to reflect the caster's new level), he must recast this spell. None of the four modifiers may be reduced below zero using this spell. These benefits are only received when the suit of armor is worn by the owner. For the purposes of this spell, the suit of armor must be of AT 5 or higher (and does not apply to the caster's “natural” AT).

sp-06432.description_en: Creates greaves of force which protect the caster's legs and arms. These do not interfere with spellcasting or maneuvers, nor do they raise the caster's Defensive Bonus or Armor Type. For the purposes of critical resolution however, the caster should be treated as wearing full greaves protecting arms and legs, and material equivalent should be deemed as whichever of “leather” or “metal” is most beneficial to the caster for a given critical. The greaves cannot be combined with “real” (i.e., physical) greaves.

sp-06433.description_en: This temporarily enchants the caster's shield conferring a special bonus of +10 to DB.

sp-06434.description_en: This temporarily enchants the caster's Personal Armor conferring a special bonus of +10 to DB.

sp-06435.description_en: Creates a helm of force which protects the caster's head. This will not interfere with spellcasting or maneuvers, nor will it raise the caster's Defensive Bonus or Armor Type. For the purposes of critical resolution however, the caster should be treated as wearing a full metal helm. The helm cannot be combined with a “real” (i.e., physical) helm.

sp-06436.description_en: This spell allows the caster to don (put on) and doff (take off) his Personal Armor in one-fifth of the normal time. It will take a minimum of one full round to don or doff armor using this spell, and for the duration of this spell, all the caster's activity will be used in donning/doffing the armor.

sp-06437.description_en: This temporarily enchants the caster's shield conferring a special bonus of +20 to DB.

sp-06438.description_en: The caster's apparel (AT 1 or AT 2) is temporarily enchanted to protect as AT 8 for the duration of the spell.

sp-06439.description_en: This temporarily enchants the caster's Personal Armor conferring a special bonus of +20 to DB.

sp-06440.description_en: For the duration of the spell, the caster's Personal Armor is enchanted such that any concussion hit damage delivered against the caster is halved (round up). For example, if the caster would have otherwise have suffered 5 points of concussion hit damage, this spell would reduce it to 3 points. Note a strike delivering 1 hit is not reduced through this spell.

sp-06441.description_en: This temporarily enchants the caster's shield conferring a special bonus of +30 to DB.

sp-06442.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster's Personal Armor cannot be damaged through normal means or through sustaining hits or critical strikes. In addition, the Personal Armor receives an additional RR (at the level of the caster) against criticals, spells and Armor-slaying items which may destroy armor. This spell may also be cast separately upon the caster's shield to provide similar protection. Note that this does not necessarily protect the caster (just the armor).

sp-06443.description_en: The caster's apparel (AT 1 or AT 2) is temporarily enchanted to protect as AT 12 for the duration of the spell.

sp-06444.description_en: This temporarily enchants the caster's Personal Armor conferring a special bonus of +30 to DB.

sp-06445.description_en: For the duration of the spell, the caster's Personal Armor is enchanted such that any concussion hit damage delivered against the caster is reduced to a third (round up). For example, if the caster would have otherwise have suffered 5 points of concussion hit damage, this spell would reduce it to 2 points. Note a strike delivering 1 hit is not reduced through this spell.

sp-06446.description_en: The caster's apparel (AT 1 or AT 2) is temporarily enchanted to protect as AT 16 for the duration of the spell.

sp-06447.description_en: For the duration of the spell, the caster's Personal Armor is enchanted so that any elemental critical strike made against the caster is reduced by one level of severity. Thus an 'E' becomes a 'D', a 'D' becomes a 'C', a 'C' becomes a 'B', a 'B' becomes an 'A', and 'A' criticals have a special modifier of -25 to the roll. This spell is only effective against one type of Elemental attack (Heat, Cold, Electricity or Impact) chosen at time of casting (and will not protect against Mana or Void criticals from Arcane Companion).

sp-06448.description_en: The caster's apparel (AT 1 or AT 2) is temporarily enchanted to protect as AT 20 for the duration of the spell.

sp-06449.description_en: For the duration of the spell, the caster's Personal Armor is enchanted such that any mundane critical strike made against the caster is reduced by one level of severity. Thus an 'E' becomes a 'D', a 'D' becomes a 'C', a 'C' becomes a 'B', a 'B' becomes an 'A', and 'A' criticals have a special modifier of -25 to the roll. This spell is only effective against one type of mundane critical strike attack (e.g., any of Slash, Puncture, Krush, etc.) chosen at time of casting.

sp-06450.description_en: This spell is used to bond junior officers or troops to a superior officer (to allow the Enlisted target to be the target of higher level spells on this list). The caster may only have as many Enlisted troops at any given time as he has levels, but he may discharge an Enlisted soldier at any time. Otherwise the Enlistment lasts until the caster or the target is dead. The process takes 1 minute per level of the target.

sp-06451.description_en: Caster learns the exact number of viewed troops and their general type (e.g., 60% infantry, 20% cavalry, 20% archers). Typing is based on visible equipment (and may not be entirely accurate).

sp-06452.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster receives a special +25 bonus to all Signaling maneuvers. Spell does not provide the means (flags, trumpets, smoke signals etc).

sp-06453.description_en: The casting of this spell grants the caster a special bonus of +25 to his next History (Battles) maneuver (which must be made within one minute of casting this spell).

sp-06454.description_en: The caster can mentally send one command (maximum of one word per level of the caster) to a single Enlisted target (within range of this spell). The target is under no compulsion to follow the command, but will know who is the sender of the message. Communication is strictly one way.

sp-06455.description_en: The casting of this spell grants the caster a special bonus of +50 to his next Military Organization maneuver (which must be made within one minute of casting this spell).

sp-06456.description_en: The caster is aware of the location of all living Enlisted targets within the area of effect for the duration of this spell.

sp-06457.description_en: The casting of this spell grants the caster a special bonus of +50 to his next Siege Engineering maneuver (which must be made within one minute of casting this spell).

sp-06458.description_en: The casting of this spell grants the caster a special bonus of +50 to his next Tactics maneuver (which must be made within one minute of casting this spell).

sp-06459.description_en: The casting of this spell grants the caster a special bonus of +50 to his next Leadership maneuver (which must be made within one minute of casting this spell).

sp-06460.description_en: As Mental Command, except the caster can mentally send a set of commands. The set of commands is limited to a maximum of one sentence per level of the caster.

sp-06461.description_en: For the duration of the spell, the caster's voice is amplified so that it can be heard over the din of battle in the given area. This spell confers no command ability but merely allows the caster to be heard.

sp-06462.description_en: and—As Mental Command, except any or all Enlisted targets can receive the command.

sp-06463.description_en: The casting of this spell grants the caster a special bonus of +75 to all Situational Awareness (Combat) maneuvers made during the duration of this spell.

sp-06464.description_en: Any or all Enlisted targets of the caster can be compelled to follow a command of the caster (maximum of one word per level of the caster) which is not totally alien to the targets, (i.e., no suicide suggestion, but extremely dangerous orders “Charge and attack the enemy archers on the hill” can be given). Note that the targets must be able to hear the command of the caster.

sp-06465.description_en: Caster may mentally communicate with a single Enlisted target within range while both concentrate. The target will be aware of who is attempting to communicate. Communication is two-way, with neither party being under any compulsion to obey the other.

sp-06466.description_en: When cast on Enlisted troops, this provides the targets with a special bonus of +50 to all RRs versus fear and charm attacks (and provides them with unshakable morale for the duration of this spell). This will rally even previously routed troops. This spell does not protect the targets against Order or Mission spells.

sp-06467.description_en: As Mental Orders, except any or all Enlisted targets can receive the orders.

sp-06468.description_en: When cast on Enlisted troops, this will make the caster aware of the individual Enlisted troops' views on a given issue.

sp-06469.description_en: As Battle Awareness I, except the caster is also aware of the general health status (unwounded, lightly or seriously wounded, unconscious, dying) of each Enlisted target for the duration of the spell.

sp-06471.description_en: Any or all Enlisted targets of the caster will receive a bonus equal to the level of the caster to all melee attacks, missile attacks and moving maneuvers for the duration of this spell. The caster must be alive and visible for the benefits to be received, and the caster himself does not receive these benefits.

sp-06472.description_en: As Order, except the caster can give a set of commands (maximum of one sentence per level of the caster) to the Enlisted targets. (This can include “suicide missions”—“Defend this position against the enemy until you have killed all the members of the enemy forces”).

sp-06473.description_en: Allows caster to determine the status of a fortification or camp that is under siege or attack (e.g., the castle walls have been breached, but the inner bailey gates are still holding).

sp-06474.description_en: The caster is alerted if any sentient being enters or and/or exits (chosen at time of casting) the area. The alarm may be silent (empathic) or audible (volume of alarm chosen at time of casting). If set to be audible, the alarm will sound for 1 minute per level of the caster before stopping.

sp-06475.description_en: The caster may seal one breach in the defences of a camp or fortress by forming an impassible wall of force up to 10' by 10' in size. This wall can itself be breached if it sustains 10 hits per level of the caster. Otherwise it must be dispelled, bypassed, or its duration must expire.

sp-06476.description_en: This spell prevents all scrying magic from passing the barrier. Any scrying spell (this includes all informational spells) must make an RR versus the level of the caster (with a special modification of -30) or be cancelled. If the scrying spell makes its RR, it may cross the barrier unhindered.

sp-06477.description_en: This spell prevents all elemental magic from passing the barrier. Any elemental spell (this includes all spells of type E,BE and DE) must make an RR versus the level of the caster (with a special modification of -30) or be cancelled. If the elemental spell makes its RR, it may cross the barrier unhindered.

sp-06478.description_en: This spell prevents all transportation and gating magic from passing the barrier. Any such spell (this includes Teleport, Long Door, Leaving, etc.) must make an RR versus the level of the caster (with a special modification of -30) or be cancelled. If the transport spell makes its RR, it may cross the barrier unhindered.

sp-06479.description_en: Caster creates a dome of force around a given point (which may be on a mobile object) to protect an area. This force shield can sustain 10 hits per level of the caster before being destroyed. Otherwise it must be dispelled (or its duration must expire).

sp-06480.description_en: This spell prevents any sentient being from passing the barrier. Any being attempting to cross must make an RR versus a Mentalism spell attack (at the caster's level) with a special modification of -30. If the being makes its RR, the being may cross the barrier unhindered.

sp-06481.description_en: This spell prevents any spell of one specific realm (chosen at time of casting; may not select Arcane as the realm) from passing the barrier. Any such spell must make an RR versus the level of the caster (with a special modification of -30) or be cancelled. If the spell makes its RR, it may cross the barrier unhindered. .

sp-06482.description_en: The caster can create an impassable wall of force in any shape desired (with a maximum length 5' per level of the caster and height 10'; usually to surround a camp or fortification). The Palisade will protect the area. The Palisade can sustain 20 hits per level of the caster before being destroyed. As this is effectively a wall, attackers may fly over it, tunnel beneath it, or fire missiles over it. Any attempt to “climb” over it has such maneuvers modified by -75. Otherwise the Palisade must be dispelled (or its duration must expire).

sp-06483.description_en: As Alarm I, except for the area of effect.

sp-06484.description_en: As Spell Breach I, except up to three breaches may be simultaneously sealed, and each wall of force will be able to sustain 15 hits per level of the caster.

sp-06485.description_en: As Scrying Barrier, except for the area of effect and the duration.

sp-06486.description_en: As Element Barrier, except for the area of effect and the duration.

sp-06487.description_en: Caster creates an impassable spherical force

sp-06488.description_en: As Transport Barrier, except for the area of effect and the duration.

sp-06489.description_en: As Mantlet, except for the area of effect and the duration.

sp-06490.description_en: As Mind Barrier, except for the area of effect and the duration.

sp-06491.description_en: As Spell Barrier, except for the area of effect and the duration.

sp-06492.description_en: As Alarm I, except for the area of effect.

sp-06493.description_en: As Seal Breach I, except up to one breach per five levels of the caster may be simultaneously sealed, and each wall may sustain 20 hits per level of the caster.

sp-06494.description_en: As Palisade, except the maximum length of the wall is 20' per level of the caster, its height is 1' per level of the caster, and it may sustain 50 hits per level of the caster.

sp-06495.description_en: As Bastion, except for the area of effect, the duration, and the Bastion may now sustain 50 hits per level of the caster.

sp-06496.description_en: This spell allows the caster to march (moving at double normal base rate), with no exhaustion points spent, for the duration. If he stops, the spell is cancelled.

sp-06497.description_en: This spell reduces the difficulty of riding maneuvers by 3 categories for the duration of the spell (e.g., Very Hard (20) becomes Light (+10)). If the caster dismounts, the spell is cancelled.

sp-06498.description_en: This spell allows the caster to swim at base movement rate, with no exhaustion points spent, for the duration. If he stops swimming, the spell is cancelled.

sp-06499.description_en: This spell allows the caster's steed to move at double its base rate, with no exhaustion points spent, for the duration. If the steed stops, the spell is cancelled.

sp-06500.description_en: The caster may march at normal speed for the duration of this spell without making any sound. This will provide a special bonus of +10 to +50 to any Stalking maneuvers (GM discretion). If the caster stops marching, the spell is cancelled.

sp-06501.description_en: This spell allows the caster to swim at double his normal rate (i.e., as fast as he can run), with no exhaustion points spent, for the duration. If he stops swimming, the spell is cancelled.

sp-06502.description_en: This spell reduces the difficulty of moving maneuvers by 3 categories for the duration of the spell (e.g., Very Hard (-20) becomes Light (+10)). This spell can only assist with maneuvers made in in the same round as an attack is declared.

sp-06503.description_en: The caster's steed may move at its base movement rate for the duration of this spell with neither the caster nor the steed making any sound. If the caster dismounts this spell is cancelled.

sp-06504.description_en: This spell allows the caster to fly at a rate of 50' per round (about 3 mph) for the duration of the spell. If the caster stops flying, the spell is cancelled.

sp-06505.description_en: With this spell a caster can move one target a distance of 5' per level (of the caster) instantly. There can be intervening barriers if the caster specifies exact distances. If the arrival point coincides with solid or liquid material, the target

sp-06506.description_en: As Forced March, except caster can affect one target per level.

sp-06507.description_en: As Riding, except caster can affect one target per level.

sp-06508.description_en: As Swimming I, except caster can affect one target per level.

sp-06509.description_en: As Forced Ride, except caster can affect one steed per level.

sp-06510.description_en: As Rapid Deployment I, except caster can move 3 targets a distance of 15' per level instantly.

sp-06511.description_en: As Silent March, except caster can affect one target per level.

sp-06512.description_en: As Swimming II, except caster can affect one target per level.

sp-06513.description_en: As Battle Maneuver, except caster can affect one target per level.

sp-06514.description_en: As Silent Ride, except caster can affect one steed and rider per level.

sp-06515.description_en: As Rapid Deployment I, except caster can move 5 targets a distance of 25' per level instantly.

sp-06516.description_en: As Flight, except caster can affect one target per level.

sp-06517.description_en: As Rapid Deployment I, except caster can move 10 targets a distance of 50' per level instantly.

sp-06519.description_en: Caster can see 100' on a clear night as if it were day. At least some residual light is required for this spell to work.

sp-06520.description_en: Caster is protected from natural heat up to 170°F (treat as if caster were in 70˚F temperature). For temperatures above 170˚F, subtract 100°F to determine the effective temperature for the caster. Caster also receives +20 to all RRs versus heat spells and heat attacks (+20 DB versus elemental fire and heat attacks).

sp-06521.description_en: Caster is protected from natural cold down to 20°F (treat as if caster were in 70°F temperature). For temperatures below 20°F, add 50°F to determine the effective temperature for the caster. Caster also receives +20 to all RRs versus cold spells and cold attacks (+20 DB versus elemental cold and cold attacks).

sp-06522.description_en: Allows caster to go without food or water and not suffer damage as a result (i.e., provides nutrition and water for one day). If this spell is used for more than one day per level of the caster on a target, the target will start to suffer minor penalties from not eating (a cumulative -5 to all actions for that day; -10 on the next day; -15 on the next day; etc.).

sp-06523.description_en: Clots wound to reduce bleeding (i.e., hits per round) by one per every four full levels of the caster as long as caster concentrates or is immobile. Thus a 5th level caster could reduce bleeding by one hit per round (a 3 hits per round wound would become a 2 hits per round wound), whereas an 8th level caster could reduce bleeding by 2 hits per round (a 3 hits per round wound would become a 1 hit per round wound). Regardless of caster's level, this spell will always reduce bleeding by a minimum of one hit per round. This effect is permanent after 10 minutes (if the caster moves before this, the bleeding will resume at the previous rate). If caster is unconscious, the spell will operate without concentration.

sp-06524.description_en: Allows caster to land safely in a fall up to 20' per level, and to take that distance off the severity of any greater fall.

sp-06525.description_en: Caster is immediately refreshed, recovering all Exhaustion Points (up to his usual maximum). In addition, the caster is also cured of any minor intoxications (e.g., hangovers, etc.).

sp-06526.description_en: Relieves caster of one round's worth of accumulated stun per five full levels of the caster. Thus, an 8th level caster would be relieved of one round of stun, whereas a 10th level caster would be relieved of two rounds of stun. Regardless of caster's level, this spell will always relieve the caster of a minimum of one round's worth of accumulated stun.

sp-06527.description_en: Caster can breathe normally under water. This spell will not function with any liquid but water.

sp-06528.description_en: For every five full levels of the caster, the caster will heal one hit per minute of concentration. Thus, a 10th level caster could heal at a rate of 2 hits per minute, whereas a 15th level caster would heal at a rate of 3 hits per minute. Regardless of caster's level, this spell will always heal a minimum of one hit each minute. If the caster is unconscious, this spell will operate without concentration (ending when the caster reaches consciousness).

sp-06529.description_en: Caster is aware of any being within the area of effect that has hostile intentions towards him. The hostility must be directed specifically at the caster or the spell reveals nothing. The being's hostility must be active (i.e., driving the being to perform aggressive actions), not passive (i.e., hate exists, but no action is planned).

sp-06530.description_en: Will awake the caster from any unnatural sleep (e.g., Sleep spell, sleeping drug etc.). Caster takes one round to awaken.

sp-06531.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster receives an additional RR against any poison(s), and the effect of any poison which does enter or is already present in the caster's system is delayed for the duration.

sp-06532.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster receives an additional RR against any disease(s), and the effect of any disease which does enter or is already present in the caster's system is delayed for the duration.

sp-06533.description_en: The caster may ignore the effects of the first critical strike made against him. At the end of this spell's duration, all effects apply normally.

sp-06534.description_en: As Nightvision, except range is the range of normal daylight vision.

sp-06535.description_en: For the duration, the caster can breathe any gas as normal air.

sp-06536.description_en: As Detect Ambush I, except the area of effect is 100'R.

sp-06537.description_en: Caster may appear to be dead to all mundane and some magical means of detecting life. For the duration of this spell, the caster will be immobile, show no response to stimuli such as being struck, have no discernible pulse, will not appear to breathe, etc., nor will he possess any signs of mental activity detectable by Presence spells nor will he be detected by Detect Life spells. However Detect Mentalism, etc., spells will detect active magic. The duration of this spell is set at time of casting, and can only be terminated earlier than this by dispelling magic.

sp-06538.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster receives a special +25 bonus to RRs versus spells from a particular realm of power, chosen at time of casting. This spell will not function against the realm of Arcane.

sp-06539.description_en: As Awake, except there is no delay and it can be used with normal sleep and set to be triggered by any activity (e.g., attack, danger, etc.).

sp-06540.description_en: As Lion Heart I, except caster can ignore the effects of the first two critical strikes made against him.

sp-06541.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster is under the effects of Sustain Self, Heat Resistance, Cold Resistance, Poison Resistance, and Disease Resistance; except any bonuses granted from these spells is equal to +30 (this applies to Heat Resistance, Cold Resistance, Poison Resistance, and Disease Resistance).

sp-06542.description_en: Caster enchants a melee weapon which is to become his “Personal Weapon.” This spell grants the weapon a special bonus equal to +1 per level of the caster to any attacks made with this weapon. The cost to cast this spell is equal to the level of the caster. If the caster gains a level and he wishes the bonus to be increased, he must recast this spell. The weapon only gains its bonus in the hands of its owner. The special bonus is cumulative with any non-magical bonuses the weapon may possess (material, construction, and/or quality) but not with magical enhancements such as Bladerunes.

sp-06543.description_en: Caster adds 2 to his initiative roll next round.

sp-06544.description_en: The caster gains a surer grip on any weapon wielded during the spell duration, lowering its fumble range by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

sp-06545.description_en: The caster's Personal Weapon leaps into his hand, negating any penalties for drawing a weapon.

sp-06546.description_en: Caster “ties” his Personal Weapon to himself. The fumble range of the weapon will be raised by +1 per level of the caster for anyone other than the caster who attempts to wield the weapon in combat. If the caster gains in level, and he wishes the penalty to be increased as well, he must recast this spell.

sp-06547.description_en: Allows caster's Personal Weapon to cut wood as well as an axe, break stone as well as a mattock, or dig earth as well as a spade (must be designated at time of casting).

sp-06548.description_en: Caster adds 4 to his initiative roll next round.

sp-06549.description_en: If the caster makes an attack using his Personal Weapon, in the same round as this spell is cast and is successful in delivering concussion hit damage to his opponent, the amount of concussion hit damage will be doubled.

sp-06550.description_en: The caster gains a surer grip on any weapon wielded during the spell duration, lowering its fumble range by 2 (to a minimum of 1).

sp-06551.description_en: If the caster makes an attack using his Personal Weapon, in the same round as this spell is cast, any

sp-06552.description_en: Caster adds 6 to his initiative roll next round.

sp-06553.description_en: If the caster makes an attack using his Personal Weapon, in the same round as this spell is cast, and that attack delivers a critical strike to the opponent, an additional elemental critical (using the same roll) of two levels less in severity will be delivered. Thus an 'E' critical strike will yield an additional 'C' strike, a 'D' will yield an additional 'B', a 'C' will yield an additional 'A' critical, and 'A' and 'B' criticals will yield no extra critical. The type of elemental critical must be chosen at time of casting and may only be one of the following: Heat, Cold, Electricity or Impact (Mana and Void criticals from Arcane Companion may not be chosen).

sp-06554.description_en: The caster's Personal Weapon will fly through the air to his outstretched hand at a rate of 100' per round. Suitable barriers (with no openings that the weapon can physically fit through) will cause this spell to fail (e.g., the caster is in a windowless cell with a closed door).

sp-06555.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster's Personal Weapon cannot be broken normally (i.e., is not subject to the normal breakage rules). In addition, the Personal Weapon receives an additional RR (at the level of the caster) against criticals, spells and Weaponslaying items which break weapons.

sp-06556.description_en: If the caster makes an attack using his Personal Weapon, in the same round as this spell is cast, any critical strike will be treated as “Mithril” for the purposes of resolution (note that this is usually only applicable against Large and Super Large creatures).

sp-06558.description_en: Caster adds 8 to his initiative roll next round.

sp-06559.description_en: If the caster makes an attack using his Personal Weapon, in the same round as this spell is cast and is successful in delivering concussion hit damage to his opponent, the amount of concussion hit damage will be tripled.

sp-06560.description_en: As Elemental Strike I, except the critical is only one less in severity.

sp-06561.description_en: If the caster makes an attack using his Personal Weapon, in the same round as this spell is cast, any critical strike will be treated as “Holy” for the purposes of resolution (note that this is usually only applicable against Large and Super Large creatures).

sp-06562.description_en: As Elemental Strike I, except the critical is of equal severity.

sp-06563.description_en: If the caster makes an attack using his Personal Weapon, in the same round as this spell is cast, any critical strike will be treated as “Slaying” for the purposes of resolution (the creature type must be chosen at time of casting; note that this is usually only applicable against Large and Super Large creatures).

sp-06564.description_en: As any one of the Mighty Strike, Elemental Strike, or Chivalrous Blow spells per round (they may change each round).

sp-07074.description_en: This spell allows the caster to make a pact of friendship and mutual aid with one animal. The animal will kill and even sacrifice its own life willingly to fulfill its end of the pact. If either party is ever killed, the surviving member will be at -30 to all actions for one week, -20 to all actions for one week, and then at -10 to all actions for one week until the shock wears off. In addition to the friendship pact, the caster and the bonded animal can mentally communicate with each other within the bond range (normally 5' per level of the caster). Mentalism-based casters need not actually “speak” their communciation aloud, but non-Mentalism casters and the animals will find it necessary to speak (making whatever sounds the animal normally makes; the caster will understand the croaks, barks, or whatever as if they were speech). This spell does not grant either the caster or the animal the ability to communicate with other members of their partner's species. A caster may have up to one bonded animal per every five levels (round up), but each such bonding requires a separate casting of this spell. This spell does not provide the caster with an animal, and takes one hour to complete.

sp-07075.description_en: Detects if any animal in the area of effect is currently bonded. Caster may concentrate on a different 5'R each round.

sp-07076.description_en: Allows a bonded animal to go without food and water for one day without taking damage from lack of “real” nutrition.

sp-07077.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the bond range of the caster is extended to 10' per level.

sp-07078.description_en: Using this spell, the caster can heal the following injuries on any one of his bonded animals: d10 hits per level of the caster, a bleeding wound that is bleeding no more than 1 hit for every five full levels of caster (i.e., a sixth level caster could stop a 1 per round bleeding wound; while a tenth level caster could stop a 2 per round bleeding wound), or mild frostbite or burns (one area per level of the caster). For the purpose of this spell, an area of moderate frostbite or burn damage counts as two areas of mild damage, and an area of severe frostbite or burn damage counts as three areas of mild damage.

sp-07079.description_en: For the duration of this spell, caster can perceive the world through any or all of the senses of any one of his bonded animals. The caster is limited in perception by the limitations of the animal's senses (so if the animal has no color vision, the caster will not perceive color through the animal's eyes). The caster's understanding of the available sensory data is further limited to the perceptive faculties that he himself possesses (i.e., if the caster is borrowing the sonar sense of a bat and does not possess sonar himself, gibberish is received).

sp-07080.description_en: Caster can call (summon) any one of his bonded animals which will then try and come to him. The range of this call is ten times the caster's current bond range.

sp-07081.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the bond range of the caster is extended to 15' per level.

sp-07082.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the fact that the target animal is bonded to the caster is concealed from magical detection.

sp-07083.description_en: Using this spell, the caster can heal the following injuries on any one of his bonded animals (recovery time given in parentheses): one damaged muscle (1 hour), one damaged tendon (1 hour), one sprain (1 hour), any cartilage damage (1 hour), any one broken bone (1 day), or any one shattered bone or joint (1 week). This spell can only repair an injury (it cannot replace a body part).

sp-07084.description_en: The caster can choose to release any one of his bonded animals from the Bonding. The bonded animal may resist this spell. If released, the bonded animal may remain friendly to the caster but may not remain long in his presence (depending on the circumstances and its treatment during the bonded period).

sp-07085.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the bond range of the caster is extended to 20' per level.

sp-07086.description_en: Gives the direction and distance to any one of the caster's bonded animals.

sp-07087.description_en: Using this spell, the caster can heal the

sp-07088.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the bond range of the caster is extended to 25' per level.

sp-07089.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster and one of his bonded animals may interchange energy at a rate of up to one concussion hit per level of the caster or two exhaustion points per level of the caster (per round). This spell will not allow either party to gain more concussion hits or exhaustion points than their normal maximum.

sp-07090.description_en: The next spell with a fixed duration (i.e., not instant or concentration) to affect the caster will affect one of his bonded animals. The duration of the spell will be halved to reflect the sharing of magical energies. Thus, an Invisibility spell will last (at most) 12 hours. The bonded animal is subject to all the normal limitations on spells.

sp-07091.description_en: Using this spell, the caster can cure the following on any one of his bonded animals: one disease, one poison, or one mental illness. Any damage already sustained as a result of the disease, poison, or illness remains.

sp-07092.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the bond range of the caster is extended to 50' per level.

sp-07093.description_en: Using this spell, the caster can heal any injury on any one of his bonded animals, including regeneration of body parts. The recovery time will vary (d100 hours) depending on the nature of the injury (GM's discretion). If the injury is such that it would prove fatal to the bonded animal if not immediately healed, the bonded animal will remain unconsious for the duration of the recovery time (but will be healed of the damage at the end of the recovery time).

sp-07094.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the bond range of the caster is extended to 100' per level.

sp-07095.description_en: Caster studies and memorizes the form of one type of plant for use with other spells on this list.

sp-07096.description_en: Caster studies and memorizes the form of one type of animal for use with other spells on this list.

sp-07097.description_en: Caster can either increase his mass (and usually height) by 10% or reduce his mass (and usually height) by 10% per level (to a maximum of 90%). When increasing, there is no proportional increase in strength other than for movement purposes; when decreasing there is no proportional decrease in strength.

sp-07098.description_en: Caster studies and memorizes the form of one type of humanoid race for use with other spells on this list.

sp-07099.description_en: Caster studies and memorizes the form of one specific individual of a given humanoid race for use with other spells on this list.

sp-07100.description_en: Allows the caster to alter the features of his face in his current form. If he has used Study Person on a being, he can take on that being's exact facial form.

sp-07101.description_en: Allows the caster to alter his build in his current form (down to one-half and up to double current mass). If he has used Study Person on a being, he can take on that being's exact physical build.

sp-07102.description_en: Caster studies and memorizes the form of one type of magical, mythical, or legendary beast (e.g., Dragon, Unicorn, etc.) for use with other spells on this list.

sp-07103.description_en: Caster can shift his form to that of any one plant he has studied. The caster will look and feel like the plant, and will gain the scent and physical abilities of the plant.

sp-07104.description_en: Caster can shift his form to that of any one land-bound animal he has studied. The caster will look and feel like the animal, and will gain the scent, physical abilities, and movement abilities of the animal.

sp-07105.description_en: As Animal Shift I, except that the caster can shift to the form of a flying, gliding, or aquatic animal he has studied. Caster will gain the flight capabilities and/or water breathing abilities (increased lung capacity/gills) of the studied animal.

sp-07106.description_en: Caster can shift his form to that of any one humanoid race he has studied. The caster will look and feel like a member of that race, and will gain the scent, and movement abilities associated with that race. Includes flight capabilities and/or water breathing abilities if pertinent.

sp-07107.description_en: Allows the caster to alter exterior parts of his body such as skin color, hands to claws (or vice versa), adding/removing limbs or tails, etc. Caster may only make alterations using components of stored patterns (thus, a caster could only add a reptilian tail if he had previously stored a creature or being with a reptilian tail).

sp-07108.description_en: As Race Shift, except that the caster can shift his form to that of any one specific individual he has studied.

sp-07109.description_en: Caster can shift his form to that of any one landbound legendary, magical, or mythical beast he has studied. The caster will look and feel like the beast, and will gain the scent, physical abilities, and movement abilities of the beast.

sp-07110.description_en: As Plant Shift, except the caster also gains any perceptive abilities, movement abilities, physical attacks, and armor type of the studied plant.

sp-07111.description_en: As Partial Shift I, except the caster can alter the internals of his body (e.g., adjusting his eyes and brain for infravision, adding gills for underwater breathing, acquiring superior resistance to poison etc.), and alterations can only be made using components of stored patterns. Thus, a caster would need an Elf pattern stored, say, to alter his vision for Nightvision.

sp-07112.description_en: As Beast Shift I, except that the caster can shift to the form of a flying, gliding, or aquatic beast he has studied. Caster will gain the flight capabilities and/or water breathing abilities (increased lung capacity/gills) of the studied beast.

sp-07113.description_en: As either Animal Shift I or Animal Shift II, except the caster also gains the perceptive abilities, physical attacks, and natural armor type of the studied animal.

sp-07114.description_en: As Race Shift, except the caster also gains the perceptive abilities, racial physical abilities, any natural physical attacks (natural weaponry only ), and natural armor type of the studied race.

sp-07115.description_en: As Person Shift, except the caster also gains the perceptive abilities, racial physical abilities, any natural physical attacks, and natural armor type of the studied individual's race. At GM discretion, the caster may also gain any purely physical talents possessed by the studied individual, and/ or physical stat bonuses and penalties from the race.

sp-07116.description_en: As Beast Shift I or Beast Shift II, except the caster also gains the perceptive abilities, physical attacks, and natural armor type of the studied beast.

sp-07117.description_en: As any of the lower level Shift spells except the caster can change form to any Studied form (by concentrating for one round) at any time during the duration of this spell.

sp-07118.description_en: Allows the caster to gauge what the tastes of the target are (e.g., is he a collector of rare books, old maps or vintage wines, etc.).

sp-07119.description_en: The caster causes one target to perceive the item as the caster wishes. Any and all senses may be changed as the illusion is all in the target's mind. However the nature of the item may not be changed (e.g., a book will remain a book, a map will still be a map).

sp-07120.description_en: Causes the caster to be more convincing than normal, providing a +25 bonus to the caster's next attempt to influence someone verbally. This bonus lasts for the whole of the next attempt and may be applied to any appropriate maneuver (at the GM's discretion; e.g., Duping, Seduction etc.).

sp-07121.description_en: As Item Charade I, except allows the caster to completely change how he is physically perceived by one target.

sp-07122.description_en: Caster's skin becomes sensitive to magic. Whenever a spell is cast on him during the duration of this spell, his skin will tingle. He will gain no information about the spell at all, only that he was the target of magic.. This will detect even Passive or Informational spells.

sp-07123.description_en: As Item Charade I, except the target will perceive any one animal as any animal of the same type (e.g., a cat will still look like a cat, but it can be any type of cat of the same basic size).

sp-07124.description_en: Causes the next lie the caster tells to be free of the normal signs used to detect lies. This results in a special modification of -25 to any non-magical attempts at lie detection and a special bonus of +25 to any RRs versus magical attempts at lie detection.

sp-07125.description_en: Allows the caster to alter one of the following to magical/mental detections: his race, profession, or level.

sp-07126.description_en: As Minor Magic Sense, except the caster's skin is sensitive enough to detect magic in or on objects which he touches.

sp-07127.description_en: As Item Charade I, except the caster can affect 2 targets.

sp-07128.description_en: As Loquaciousness I, except the bonus is +50.

sp-07129.description_en: As Personal Charade I, except the caster can affect 2 targets.

sp-07130.description_en: As Creature Charade I, except the caster can affect 2 targets.

sp-07131.description_en: As Lesser Magic Sense, except the caster learns the realm of magic and the direction from whence the spell came (if appropriate). 15.Mental Charade II—As Mental Charade I, except the caster can alter two of the following to magical/mental detections: his level, race, or profession. Alternatively, the caster can choose only one of the items and double the duration of this spell.

sp-07133.description_en: As Item Charade I, except the caster can affect 3 targets.

sp-07134.description_en: As Loquaciousness I, except the bonus is +75.

sp-07135.description_en: As Personal Charade I, but the caster can affect 3 targets.

sp-07136.description_en: As Creature Charade I, except the caster can affect 3 targets.

sp-07137.description_en: As Greater Magic Sense, except the caster can choose an area in which to detect. He will detect any spells cast on the area after this spell is cast and any magic items that enter the area (but will not discover any magics which encompass an area larger than this spell).

sp-07138.description_en: As Mental Charade I, except the caster can alter his race, profession, and level to magical and mental detections. Alternatively, the caster can choose two of the above and double the normal duration; or the caster can choose only one of the above and triple the normal duration.

sp-07139.description_en: As Item Charade I, except the caster can manipulate the perceptions of a number of targets up to a maximum of caster's level divided by 5.

sp-07140.description_en: As Personal Charade I, except the caster can manipulate the perceptions of a number of targets up to a maximum of caster'a level divided by 5.

sp-07141.description_en: The target falls into natural sleep. The first round is a magical sleep (the target cannot be awakened through normal means).

sp-07142.description_en: The caster may store the dream pattern of a daydream or sleeping dream of a given target for future use. The caster may only have as many daydream patterns and as many sleeping dream patterns stored as his Memory stat (not the stat bonus) and may release a stored pattern at any given time. The caster's player is responsible for recording which patterns are stored. Note that the caster cannot be the target of this spell.

sp-07143.description_en: The caster may store the dreamself pattern of a given target (for use with spells on this list and on the Dream Lore list). The caster must also be asleep at time of casting. The caster may only have as many dream-self patterns stored as his Memory stat (not stat bonus) and may release a stored pattern at any given time. The caster's player is responsible for recording which patterns are stored.

sp-07144.description_en: The caster can passively share (by concentrating upon this spell) any daydreams experienced by the target during the spell's duration. He will receive not only the events of the daydream but the reactions and surface thoughts which arise as a result of the daydream.

sp-07145.description_en: The caster can passively share (by concentrating upon this spell) any sleeping dreams experienced by the target during the spell's duration.

sp-07146.description_en: The caster may induce a daydream in the target's mind, distracting the target for as long as the target entertains the daydream (or perhaps as long as the daydream entertains the target!). The caster may elect to either induce a random daydream (allowing the target's mind to supply the topic and the details), a daydream on a specific topic (the target's mind supplies the details), or a daydream pattern previously stored by the caster.

sp-07147.description_en: The caster can locate the chosen target in terms of both direction and distance. The caster must have previously stored the target's dream-self pattern, the target must be asleep, and the target must be within 100' per level of the caster at time of casting.

sp-07148.description_en: The caster may induce a dream (not of nightmarish aspect) in a sleeping target. The caster may elect to either induce a dream on a specific topic (the target's mind supplies the details) or to use a dream pattern previously stored by the caster.

sp-07149.description_en: This spell causes a portion of the target's subconscious mind to monitor any attempts by others to detect, store, observe, or manipulate the target's dream-self pattern (or his dreams) for the duration of his sleep cycle. Such spells must make an RR versus the level of the caster (if the RR is successful the detection, etc., may proceed normally). If the RR fails, the target's subconscious is alerted to the nature of the incoming spell and it relays this information to the caster's conscious mind (and the incoming spell fails). The caster of this spell must be awake and within 50' of the target to receive any warnings.

sp-07150.description_en: As Induce Dream, except the caster may induce a nightmare (with ramifications at the GM's discretion).

sp-07151.description_en: By concentrating with this spell, the caster can create a daydream on any topic he desires with the level of detail limited by the caster's imagination, and the duration of the spell limited only by the caster's ability to concentrate. Once the caster has completed his weaving, he must concentrate for a further round to store the parameters for future use (this counts as a dream stored with the Store Dream Pattern spell). If the caster's concentration is interrupted or ends before the creation is complete, the daydream will also be incomplete. Note the caster can decide to leave certain aspects of the dream to be created spontaneously by the minds of targets in which the daydream is later induced.

sp-07152.description_en: The target of this spell will be unable to dream during his next sleep cycle if he fails to resist this spell.

sp-07153.description_en: As Weave Daydream, except the caster weaves a normal dream (not a nightmare).

sp-07154.description_en: As Locate Dreamer I, except the range is 1,000' per level of the caster.

sp-07155.description_en: As Weave Dream, except the caster weaves a nightmare.

sp-07156.description_en: The target of this spell will be unable to sleep, and will therefore forfeit any benefits that the lost sleep would have provided (healing, PP recovery, etc.).

sp-07157.description_en: As Daydream, except affects one target per level of the caster chosen at time of casting and the caster may only induce a specific daydream pattern which will be shared by all the targets.

sp-07158.description_en: As Locate Dreamer I, except the range is 1 mile per level of the caster.

sp-07159.description_en: As Dream, except affects one target per level of the caster chosen at time of casting and the caster may only induce a specific dream pattern which will be shared by all the targets.

sp-07160.description_en: As Nightmare, except affects one target per level of the caster chosen at time of casting and the caster may only induce a specific dream pattern which will be shared by all the targets.

sp-07161.description_en: As Locate Dreamer I, except the range is unlimited.

sp-07162.description_en: This subconsciously activated spell will awaken the caster from any form of sleep (magical or nonmagical). The caster will require only one round to come fully awake. This spell works by assimilating sensory cues from the caster's surroundings and allowing the caster's subconscious to determine if the caster should awaken in response.

sp-07163.description_en: Caster has a dream relating to a topic decided upon just before retiring. The caster must sleep for a normal sleep cycle (minimum of 3 hours) for this spell to work.

sp-07164.description_en: By casting this spell prior to retiring, the caster can fully control his next sleep cycle, allowing him to fall asleep at his own pace (instantly or gradually; even in noisy or otherwise disruptive environments) and to set the duration of the sleep cycle.

sp-07165.description_en: The caster may store the parameters of one of his own dreams for use with spells later on this list and on the Dream Law spell list. The caster can only store as many sleeping dream patterns equal to his Memory stat (not stat bonus). The caster may release a dream pattern at any time. The caster's player is responsible for noting which dream patterns are stored.

sp-07167.description_en: As Dream I, except the limit is 2 dreams per sleep cycle on different topics.

sp-07168.description_en: The caster can enter the sleeping dreams or nightmares of one or more targets chosen at time of casting prior to retiring. The caster must have previously stored each target's Dreamer Pattern. In addition, each target must be asleep, must be able to dream (i.e., is not under an Undream or equivalent spell), and each target's pattern must not be concealed (i.e., is not under the effects of a Dream Cloak, Dream Masquerade, Dream Invisibility, or equivalent spell). The target(s) must be no further than 100' per level of the caster away. The caster may only enter the dreams or nightmares of more than one target if all the desired targets are experiencing the same dream or nightmare. Upon entry to a target's dreams, the caster may choose merely to passively observe or to interact with the dream and/or dreamer.

sp-07169.description_en: As Dream I, except the caster has a “lucid” dream which will initially relate to a topic decided upon just before retiring. Alternatively the caster may choose to repeat a stored Dream pattern.

sp-07170.description_en: By casting this spell just before retiring, the caster assigns a portion of his subconscious mind to monitor any attempts by others to detect, store, observe or manipulate the caster dream-self pattern or his dreams for the duration of his sleep cycle. Such spells must make an RR versus the caster's level. If the RR succeeds, the attempt may proceed normally. If the RR fails, the caster's subconscious is alerted to the nature of the incoming spell and the attempt fails.

sp-07171.description_en: As Dream I, except the limit is 3 dreams per sleep cycle on different topics.

sp-07172.description_en: By casting this spell just before retiring, the caster increases the rate at which his body heals during the sleep cycle, regaining twice as many concussion hits as normal. Additionally other injuries heal at twice normal rate during the healing sleep.

sp-07174.description_en: By casting this spell before retiring, the caster can conceal his dream-self pattern and any dreams he may experience for the duration of his sleep cycle. This

sp-07175.description_en: As Enter Dreams I, except for the range.

sp-07176.description_en: As Dream I, except the limit is 5 dreams per sleep cycle on any combination of topics chosen by the caster.

sp-07177.description_en: As Lucid Dream I, except the limit is 2 “lucid” dreams per sleep cycle on different topics.

sp-07179.description_en: As Dream Healing II, except the caster recovers three times normal concussion hits and other injuries heal at three times normal rate.

sp-07180.description_en: As Enter Dreams I, except for the range.

sp-07181.description_en: As Lucid Dream I, except the limit is 3 “lucid” dreams per sleep cycle on different topics.

sp-07183.description_en: As Enter Dreams I, except for the range.

sp-07184.description_en: When cast on a target before sleep, this spell prevents the target's dream self from entering or being drawn into the dream world for the duration of the target's sleep period.

sp-07185.description_en: When cast on a target (either before or after entry to the dream world), this spell allows the target to use his skills and innate abilities at 25% of their normal value within the dream world (for the duration of this spell). This spell does not allow the caster to cast spells while in the dream world. Without an Empowerment spell, a dream-self persona cannot manipulate the dream world.
