sp-07186.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the target is able to cast first level spells while in the dream world. This spell can be cast either before or after entry to the dream world. Without this spell, the target's spells will have no effect in the dream world.

sp-07187.description_en: Allows the caster to slow down the metabolism of the target's real body for the duration of the spell. The target's body does not require nourishment for the duration of the spell. The spell only functions while the target remains in the dream world.

sp-07188.description_en: Allows the caster to draw the dream self of a sleeping target into a specific location in the dream world chosen at time of casting. The target will remain in the dream world for the duration of his sleep, unless an Exit Dream World spell

sp-07189.description_en: Allows the caster to force a target's dream self out of the dream world. The target will waken in one round after being ejected. This spell cannot be used to eject a creature belonging to the dream world.

sp-07190.description_en: As Dream Empowerment I, except the target can use his skills and abilities at 50% of their normal value.

sp-07191.description_en: As Dream Spell I, except the target can cast up to thirrd level spells.

sp-07192.description_en: When cast on a target, this spell will provide the target's subconscious mind with a warning of any danger to the target's physical body for the duration of the spell.

sp-07193.description_en: The caster may teleport one target to a location within the dream world with which the caster is either familiar or is familiar with its real world equivalent. The risk of this spell depends on the caster's familiarity with the destination. The following chances for failure exist: Never seen place (but has had described) = 50%; Been briefly (one hour or less) = 25%; Studied (been in for 24 hours)=10%; Studied carefully (7 days) = 1 %. In the case of failure, first determine the direction of the error (roll randomly) The amount of error is then determined by making a d100 (openended) roll to determine the distance of the error in feet.

sp-07194.description_en: This spell will inform the caster of the location in the dream world of the dream-self of a single chosen target who must be in the dream world at time of casting and known to the caster.

sp-07195.description_en: As Dream Spell I, except the target can cast up to fifth level spells.

sp-07196.description_en: As Dream Empowerment I, except the target can use his skills and abilities at 75% of their normal value.

sp-07197.description_en: Allows the caster to summon a dream beast. The dream beast may or may not be friendly towards the caster, and the caster may or may not be able to summon a specific type or individual dream beast dependent on the nature of the dream world.

sp-07198.description_en: The target's dream-self will be prevented from returning to his physical body. The target may make additional RRs to break free if the physical body is attacked or endangered during the duration of this spell.

sp-07199.description_en: As Summon Dream Beast, except the caster can summon an intelligent denizen of the dream world.

sp-07200.description_en: The target dream beast will believe the caster is a good friend.

sp-07201.description_en: As Dream Spell I, except the target can cast up to tenth level spells.

sp-07202.description_en: As Charm Dream Beast, except this spell affects intelligent denizens of the dream world.

sp-07203.description_en: ue—As Dream Empowerment I, except the target can use his skills and abilities at 100% of their normal value.

sp-07204.description_en: As Dream Teleport I, except the caster may teleport up to one target per level of the caster.

sp-07205.description_en: As Dream Spell I, except the target can cast up to twentieth level spells.

sp-07206.description_en: As Dream Spell I, except the target can cast up to fiftieth level spells.

sp-07207.description_en: Adds +20 to the caster's Appearance. This cannot raise the caster's Appearance above 100.

sp-07208.description_en: Caster learns details about the target's romantic emotional attachments (if any) and sexual preferences.

sp-07209.description_en: Adds +25 to any Seduction maneuvers for the duration of this spell.

sp-07210.description_en: The target will believe everything the caster says, unless the target has prior (or incontrovertible evidence) to the contrary.

sp-07211.description_en: Caster studies and memorizes the appearance and mannerisms of a being, for later use in a Face Shifting True or Change type spell. The caster can only have as many forms studied as he has levels.

sp-07212.description_en: Allows the caster to alter the form of his face. If he has used Study Individual, he can take on the exact facial form.

sp-07213.description_en: Adds +15 to any maneuvers using any skill in the Influence skill category (except Seduction).

sp-07214.description_en: The caster receives a +15 bonus to all performing skills (in the Artistic • Active category) for the duration of this spell.

sp-07215.description_en: As Face Shifting True, except the caster can alter his build and the shape of his body.

sp-07216.description_en: As Enhance Beauty I, except the bonus is +40 and the maximum is 101.

sp-07217.description_en: Caster can alter his entire body to the form of another humanoid race (no increase in mass). This spell is insufficient in itself to allow the caster to impersonate a specific being.

sp-07218.description_en: As Entertain I, except the bonus is +30.

sp-07219.description_en: As Influence I, except the bonus is +30.

sp-07220.description_en: Caster changes to become a member of the opposite sex in terms of purely physical factors. The caster is sterile for the duration of this spell. This spell can be used in combination with Racial Change and other spells.

sp-07221.description_en: As Seduction I, except the bonus is +50.

sp-07222.description_en: As Entertain I, except the bonus is +45.

sp-07223.description_en: Caster may appear to be any age desired, chosen at time of casting.

sp-07224.description_en: As Enhance Beauty I, except the bonus is +40 and the maximum is 103.

sp-07225.description_en: As Influence I, except the bonus is +45.

sp-07226.description_en: As Entertain I, except the bonus is +60.

sp-07227.description_en: As Seduction I, except the bonus is +75.

sp-07228.description_en: As Change Sex, except the caster becomes a true member of the opposite sex (i.e., genetics, personality, and all psychological factors are also changed, and the caster may choose whether to be sterile for the duration (choice must be made at time of casting).

sp-07229.description_en: Caster has two years of his age “removed” (i.e., rejuvenation). If the spell fails, the caster is killed and the total true age returns immediately. The spell may be cast repeatedly and effects are cumulative; however, each time it is cast on the caster, the unmodified failure chance increases by 1.

sp-07230.description_en: The target believes the caster is a good friend.

sp-07231.description_en: The target loses 20% of his remaining concussion hits.

sp-07233.description_en: The target is in “seventh heaven” (i.e., extreme ecstasy, joy, etc.), and may only spend 50% activity for the duration of this spell (i.e., he does not have a full 100% activity each round). The pleasure engendered is addictive and the target may act irrationally or allow himself to be manipulated to obtain a further “dose.”

sp-07234.description_en: As Kiss of Pain, except the target loses 40% of his remaining hits.

sp-07235.description_en: The target falls into a deep natural sleep. The first d10 rounds are magical (i.e., the target cannot be awakened by normal means).

sp-07236.description_en: The target is extremely jealous of a person chosen by the caster and will act on this emotion according to his (the target's) nature.

sp-07237.description_en: As Kiss of Pain, except the target loses 60% of his remaining hits.

sp-07238.description_en: The target feels physically drained. His Strength stat bonus reduced by 10.

sp-07239.description_en: Enables the next Kiss spell (if cast within 1 minute) to affect a target of the same sex and race as the caster.

sp-07241.description_en: As Kiss of Pain, except the target loses 90% of his remaining hits.

sp-07242.description_en: As Kiss of Impotence, except the duration is permanent.

sp-07243.description_en: The target will obey the caster in any suggested act that is not completely alien to him (e.g., no suicide orders, no blinding himself, etc.).

sp-07244.description_en: As Minor Kiss, except enables the next Kiss spell (if cast within 1 minute) to affect a target of any sex belonging to another humanoid race.

sp-07245.description_en: As Kiss of Jealousy, except the emotion is hate.

sp-07246.description_en: The target is an amnesiac, remembering nothing of his past for the duration of his spell.

sp-07247.description_en: As Kiss of Jealousy, except the emotion is love.

sp-07248.description_en: The target falls into a deep coma.

sp-07249.description_en: As Minor Kiss, except enables the next Kiss spell (if cast within 1 minute) to affect any sentient target of any sex.

sp-07250.description_en: Causes the effect of the next Kiss spell (if cast within 1 minute) to be delayed for up to 1 minute per level of the caster.

sp-07251.description_en: Causes the next Kiss spell (if cast within 1 minute) to have a range of 50'.

sp-07252.description_en: As Kiss of Coma, except the target will die immediately if he fails his RR by more than -50.

sp-07253.description_en: Allows caster virtual totall recall of any conversation or writing he encountered within a period of days equal to his level.

sp-07254.description_en: Doubles the rate at which the caster can learn a language. Every rank of language developed (i.e., DPs spent), results in two ranks being learned. It is assumed that this spell is cast and in effect while the language is being learned.

sp-07255.description_en: Caster learns what language a piece of text is written in, and the author if he was noteworthy or the caster has seen his work previously.

sp-07256.description_en: Caster can read at three times the normal rate (resulting in 3 pages per minute while this spell is active).

sp-07257.description_en: Allows the caster to access his memory as if he had total recall. Any manuever involving Memory receives a special bonus of +25.

sp-07258.description_en: Caster gains information regarding one manuscript including type of paper/parchment, type of binding (if any), type of ink, date of writing/printing, date of binding (if any), magical or normal, etc. No information will be provided on the content of the text.

sp-07259.description_en: Caster gains insights or facts by observing a person or thing with intense concentration. Gives the caster a +50 modification to an appropriate Awareness maneuver.

sp-07260.description_en: As Learn Language II, except rate is tripled (and three ranks are gained for every one).

sp-07261.description_en: Caster can read at five times the normal rate (resulting in 5 pages per minute while this spell is active).

sp-07262.description_en: Caster is able to correlate known facts to obtain conclusions. Any maneuver involving Reasoning receives a special bonus of+25.

sp-07263.description_en: Caster can read a piece of text and tell if it is a translation: and if so, what the original language was and possibly the author if he was noteworthy or the caster has seen his work before.

sp-07264.description_en: This spell copies a document that the caster is examining. The caster merely concentrates and touches the document with one hand and a blank sheet with his other hand. The copy is exact and in full color. Note the caster does not have to be able to read the document. The process occurs at a rate of one page per round.

sp-07266.description_en: Caster can read at ten times the normal rate (resulting in 10 pages per minute while this spell is active).

sp-07267.description_en: As Learn Language II, except rate is four times normal (and four ranks are gained for every one).

sp-07268.description_en: As Recall I, except the bonus of +50. Not cumulative with Recall I.

sp-07269.description_en: As Study II, except caster can read as fast as he can glance at a page.

sp-07270.description_en: As Observation I, except virtually every detail in even a large situation is noted, and the bonus is +100. Not cumulative with Observation I.

sp-07271.description_en: As Passage Origin I, except the caster can tell how many times the text has been translated, what languages the text has been through, who the translators were, and who the original author was.

sp-07272.description_en: As Correlations I, except the bonus is +50. Not cumulative with Correlations I.

sp-07273.description_en: As Learn Language II, except rate is five times normal (and five ranks are gained for every one).

sp-07275.description_en: As Learn Language II, except rate is ten times normal (and ten ranks are gained for every one).

sp-07276.description_en: Caster learns if any illness or disease is effecting the target. Caster also learns the number of illnesses/diseases, but not their nature.

sp-07277.description_en: Caster learns if any poison is effecting the target. Caster also learns the number of toxins, but not their nature.

sp-07278.description_en: Caster learns if any physical malady (i.e., broken bone, sprains, tendon/muscle damage, internal bleeding etc. but not diseases or poisons) is effecting the target. Caster also learns the number of illnesses/diseases and a general location of each malady.

sp-07279.description_en: Creates clean incision into living material a predetermined length and depth. The incision will not bleed for the duration of the spell.

sp-07280.description_en: Closes any one wound (leaving only a small scar). In the case of a normal wound (i.e., not caused by an Incision), the binding should be treated as a sewn wound (which may reopen under stress).

sp-07281.description_en: Removes any foreign material from an open wound.

sp-07282.description_en: Caster learns if any mental illness or disease is affecting the target. Caster also learns the number of such problems, but not their nature.

sp-07283.description_en: Stops infection/spread of one disease in the target. No further damage will occur in uninfected areas of the body for the duration of this spell. Damage already sustained is not cured. The disease must be specified at time of casting. This spell can be used preemptively to prevent the infection of a healthy person (this results in any RRs versus the specified disease being modifiedy by +50).

sp-07284.description_en: Allows the caster to set any bone or joint (simple or compound fracture, or shatters) in the correct position for natural healing. Appropriate support will be necessary to ensure the bone or joint stays in place until healing is well underway.

sp-07285.description_en: Stabilises one poison in the system of the target. No further damage will occur for the duration of this spell. Damage already sustained is not cured. The poison must be specified at time of casting. This spell can be used preemptively to prevent the infection of a healthy person (this results in any RRs versus the specified poison being modifiedy by +50).

sp-07286.description_en: Caster acquires complete knowledge of one diesase affecting the target including name, type, and expected effect(s) of the disease, and cure and necessary treatment required. The spell does not give the caster the skill, the power or the materials to effect the cure.

sp-07287.description_en: Caster acquires complete knowledge of one poison effecting the target including name, type, and expected effect(s) of the poison, and cure and necessary treatment required. The spell does not give the caster the skill, the power or the materials to effect the cure.

sp-07288.description_en: Allows a caster to completely clean one wound of any type of natural infection. The spell will not keep an open wound clean and it will be necessary to remove the material causing the infection.

sp-07290.description_en: The caster can revive the target after any sudden lapse in bodily functions (due to drowning, heart attack, shock, etc.), but the bodily functions cannot have lapsed for more than 1 round per level of the caster. This spell will restore bodily functions to normal heart rate, breathing, etc. Body must have proper attention and the cause of the lapse must be removed to prevent a recurrence.

sp-07291.description_en: Caster acquires complete knowledge of one mental problem affecting the target including name, type, and expected effect(s) of the malady, and cure and necessary treatment required. The spell does not give the caster the skill, the power or the materials to effect the cure.

sp-07292.description_en: Completely numbs part or all of a target's body for surgical procedures for the duration of the spell. The target is not rendered unconscious.

sp-07293.description_en: Will perfectly preserve a body or portion thereof (even if the portion is separated from a living host). The tissue is preserved in exactly the same condition it was in at time of casting.

sp-07294.description_en: Gives the caster a mental “still picture” of the interior of a target's body, which may be of the entire body or a specific region. If the picture is of the entire body, it will reveal broken bones, massive trauma etc, while if it is of a specific bodily part, it may show detail at the level of blocked blood vessels, damaged muscles etc.

sp-07295.description_en: Caster causes the target to become transparent and insubstantial, allowing the caster to imbed his hands inside the target, without causing any harm, and perform minor surgery or remove alien objects (caster can concentrate to make any portion of the target substantial enough to perform the surgery or procedure). Caster must still use any required tools or spells. The spell only affects living tissue.

sp-07296.description_en: As Local Anesthesia, except the target is rendered deeply unconscious for the duration.

sp-07297.description_en: As Resuscitation, except the lapse can be up to 1 minute per level of the caster.

sp-07298.description_en: Caster gains and stores all mental and emotional information about target. This information is only accessible via the higher level spells on this list.

sp-07299.description_en: Allows caster to know the general emotions/outlook of a studied humanoid, either in terms of a typical member of the race or the specific individual.

sp-07300.description_en: Allows caster to know the general emotions/outlook of a studied sentient plant, animal or beast, either in terms of a typical member of the species or the specific individual.

sp-07301.description_en: Allows caster to know the gender, race, profession and level (if any) of a studied individual at time of Study.

sp-07302.description_en: Allows caster to know the number, nature, and value of all skills (excluding spell lists; if any) possessed by a studied individual at time of Study.

sp-07303.description_en: Allows caster to know the number, nature, and levels known of all spell lists (if any) and special mental abilities (if any) possessed by an individual at time of Study.

sp-07304.description_en: Caster can consult the conscious memories and experiences of a studied individual at a rate of one “scene” per round.

sp-07306.description_en: Caster can mimic the emotions/outlook of a studied sentient plant, animal or beast, either in terms of a typical member of the species or the specific individual.

sp-07307.description_en: Caster can mentally become the gender, race, level and/or profession of any Studied race or individual, and will register as such by magical detections. Caster retains his own skills, profession, and racial bonuses. Also, any attribute that the caster does not choose to shift, he will retain. For example, a male Gnomish Shapeshifter (10th level Mentalist) has previously Studied a female Wood Elf Ranger (12th level), and now elects to Mental Shift, choosing to shift only race and profession. Assuming the spell is successful, he will now detect as a male 10th level Wood Elf Ranger (and may think like a Wood Elf Ranger).

sp-07308.description_en: Caster can draw upon the conscious memories of the Studied pattern in response to current stimuli.

sp-07309.description_en: Caster can use the studied individual's native language to the level of fluency (spoken and written) of the individual at time of Study.

sp-07310.description_en: Caster can use one purely mental skill (a skill that uses any combination of the following stat bonuses: Memory, Reasoning, Empathy, Intuition, or Presence) of a Studied individual at the skill bonus of that individual at time of Study.

sp-07311.description_en: Caster can use one non-combat (not OB related) physical or mental skill of a Studied individual at the skill bonus of that individual at time of Study.

sp-07312.description_en: Caster can use one combat skill (OB related) of a Studied individual at the skill bonus of that individual at time of Study.

sp-07313.description_en: Caster may use one spell list known by a Studied individual to the level known by that individual at time of Study. However, the caster must use his own PPs and must always make a Spell Casting Static Maneuver, with all appropriate penalties taken into consideration. Should the spell casting maneuver fail, the spell failure roll will receive a special modification of +50.

sp-07314.description_en: Caster can use any language known by the studied individual to the level of fluency (spoken and written) of the individual at time of Study.

sp-07315.description_en: As Skill Shift I, except the caster can use up to one purely mental skill per level from a single Studied individual.

sp-07316.description_en: As Skill Shift II, except the caster can use up to one non-combat physical or mental skill per level from a single Studied individual.

sp-07317.description_en: As Skill Shift III, except the caster can use up to one combat skill per level from a single Studied individual.

sp-07318.description_en: As Mystical Shift I, except the caster can use up to one spell list per level from a single Studied individual.

sp-07319.description_en: As any of the lower level Shift spells except caster can mind shift to a different pattern at any time during the 24 hours by concentrating for one full round.

sp-07320.description_en: Allows caster to determine from a sample the nature of a medicine or poison including origins, purity, general value, effect, plus type and antidote (if any) in the case of poisons.

sp-07321.description_en: Caster produces one dose of a medication which acts as an analgesic, providing temporary relief from minor muscular pain (i.e., allowing the beneficiary to ignore any one penalty of -10 or less due to muscular pain). The effects will last ten minutes per level of the caster.

sp-07322.description_en: Caster produces one dose of a medication which will temporarily alleviate one symptom of a minor ailment or illness (determined at time of casting). Examples include alleviating the queasiness and vertigo associated with nausea, alleviating sneezing, rashes, watery eyes etc. associated with an allergic reaction (because of pollen, animal hair, etc.), reducing a fever by one degree per level of the caster etc. The effects will last ten minutes per level of the caster.

sp-07323.description_en: Caster produces one dose of a medication which acts as an anesthetic, inducing unconsciousness, stupor, or insensitivity to pain (rendering the patient unable to act). The effects will last ten minutes per level of the caster.

sp-07324.description_en: Caster produces one dose of a medication which will reduce the effects of an infection or parasitic infestation,, killing bacteria, viruses, or parasites on contact. The effects will last thirty minutes per level of the caster.

sp-07325.description_en: Caster produces one dose of an antidote to one specific poison (of 10th level or less). The specific poison must be specified at time of casting. Damage already sustained is not cured. This spell has its failure chance raised by 1 per level of the poison.

sp-07326.description_en: Caster produces one dose of a medication which will either render the target fertile or infertile. A fertility medication will ensure conception will occur, whereas an infertility medication will act as a contraceptive. The effects will last one day per level of the caster.

sp-07327.description_en: Caster produces a medication which will cure any one disease (of 10th level or less). The specific disease

sp-07328.description_en: Caster produces a medication which will heal 3d10 concussion hits.

sp-07329.description_en: Caster produces a medication which will stop any blood loss from one wound.

sp-07330.description_en: Caster produces a physick which will heal any one area of skin damage (scarring, burn, etc.). The recovery period is up to an hour (depending on the severity of the injury).

sp-07331.description_en: Caster produces a medication which will repair damaged cartilage. The recovery period is one day.

sp-07332.description_en: Caster produces a physick which will heal any hair or nail loss or damage. The recovery period is one day.

sp-07333.description_en: Caster produces a physick which will repair a damaged muscle. The recovery period is up to 10 hours dependent on the severity of the injury.

sp-07334.description_en: Caster produces a physick which will repair a damaged tendon. The recovery period is up to 10 hours dependent on the severity of the injury.

sp-07335.description_en: Caster produces a medication which will repair a damaged, broken (simple or compound fractures) or shattered bone (but not joints). The recovery period is up to 10 days dependent on the severity of the damage (e.g., a simple fracture would take one day, a shattered bone ten days to heal).

sp-07336.description_en: As Lesser Antidote, except the poison can be any level.

sp-07337.description_en: As Lesser Disease Curative, except the disease can be of any level.

sp-07338.description_en: Caster produces a medicine which repairs a damaged nerve. The recovery period is one day.

sp-07339.description_en: Caster produces a medication which will repair a damaged, broken (simple or compound fracture) or shattered joint. The recovery period is up to 10 days dependent on the severity of the damage (e.g., a chipped joint would take one day, a shattered joint ten days to heal).

sp-07341.description_en: Caster produces a physick which will repair any one damaged organ (except the brain). The recovery period is up to 10 days dependent on the severity of the injury.

sp-07342.description_en: Caster produces a physick which will heal any damage to the brain, restoring memory loss and removing insanity (but not posssession or mental curses).The recovery period is up to days dependent on the severity of the injury.

sp-07343.description_en: Allows caster to know his current location in the ocean to within ±d10 miles. The caster can also tell which way is north.

sp-07344.description_en: Allows caster to determine the height of the tide, whether it is coming in or going out, the maximum height (or depth) and the time it will reach apogee (or perigee).

sp-07345.description_en: Allows the caster to determine the depth of the water within range at any point. The information will include maximum, minimum, and average depth.

sp-07346.description_en: Caster can see 100' on a clear night as if it were day. At least some residual light is required for this spell to work.

sp-07347.description_en: This spell allows the caster to swim at double his normal base movement rate (i.e., as fast as he can run), with no exhaustion points spent, for the duration. If he stops swimming, the spell is cancelled.

sp-07348.description_en: This spell allows the caster to row at double normal rate, with no exhaustion points spent, for the duration. If he stops rowing, the spell is cancelled.

sp-07349.description_en: This spell allows the caster to make no sound while rowing at the normal rate for the duration (i.e., there will be no sound from the rowlocks nor from the entry/exit of the oar into the water). If he stops rowing, the spell is cancelled.

sp-07350.description_en: As Nightvision, except caster can see 100' in any precipitation or gas.

sp-07351.description_en: This spell allows the caster to make no sound while swimming at normal rate, and “camouflages” the caster against the water, making him difficult to spot (-50 to Awareness maneuvers to notice the caster). If the caster stops swimming, the spell is cancelled.

sp-07352.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster receives a special +25 bonus to all Sailing maneuvers.

sp-07353.description_en: Caster may run on water (i.e., move at double his normal base pace) and will expend exhaustion points as normal. GMs may require maneuver rolls if the water is rough.

sp-07354.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster receives a special +25 bonus to all Drafting, Mapping, and/ or Cartography maneuvers.

sp-07355.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster can see underwater to a distance of 10'/lvl (some residual light must be available). In addition, the caster may also breathe water as well as air.

sp-07356.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster receives a special +25 bonus to all Navigation maneuvers.

sp-07357.description_en: As Nightvision and Fogvision, except the caster's range of vision is normal daylight range (i.e., to the horizon).

sp-07358.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster receives a special +25 bonus to all Boat Piloting maneuvers.

sp-07359.description_en: As Swimming II, except caster can affect one target per level.

sp-07360.description_en: As Forced Row, except caster can affect one target per level.

sp-07361.description_en: As Silent Row, except caster can affect one target per level.

sp-07362.description_en: As Ghost Swim, except caster can affect one target per level.

sp-07363.description_en: As Water Running, except caster can affect one target per level.

sp-07364.description_en: As Water Survival, except caster can affect one target per level.

sp-07365.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster receives a special +50 bonus to all Sailing, Drafting, Mapping, Cartography, Navigation and Boat Pilot maneuvers.

sp-07366.description_en: Gives caster a 95% chance of predicting the time (±15 minutes), direction (within one point on the compass), and speed of winds (±5 mph) over the next 24 hour period in an area designated at time of casting.

sp-07367.description_en: Gives caster a 95% chance of predicting the time (±15 minutes) and type of precipitation over the next 24 hour period in an area designated at time of casting.

sp-07368.description_en: Gives caster a 95% chance of predicting the time (±15 minutes) and type of storms over the next 24 hour period in an area designated at time of casting.

sp-07369.description_en: Gives caster a 95% chance of predicting the time (±15 minutes), type, and severity of weather over the next 24 hour period in an area designated at time of casting.

sp-07370.description_en: All fog or mist in the area is dissipated. Magically created fog or mist may receive an RR (GM's discretion).

sp-07371.description_en: Caster causes fog to arise that obscures all vision in and through the area. Normal vision inside the fog is limited to approximately 1'. All missile attacks into or out of the fog are modified at -10 to -50 (GM discretion).

sp-07372.description_en: The area of effect for this spell is 1' per level around the boat that the

sp-07373.description_en: As Predict Weather I, except the area of the forecast is 3 miles per level of the caster in radius.

sp-07374.description_en: As Waveshield, except this spell protects the ship from all inclement weather (but not winds). Thus fogs, mists, rain, snow etc., will not affect the ship (i.e., no rain will fall in the protected area, fog will remain outside the protected area). Weather created as a result of magic may receive an RR (GM's discretion).

sp-07375.description_en: The area of effect for this spell is the water immediately surrounding the boat or ship the caster is on. For as long as the caster concentrates, the speed of the ship or boat can be increased by 50' per round (approximately 3 miles per hour).

sp-07376.description_en: As Clear Fog, except for the area.

sp-07377.description_en: As Predict Weather I, except for the area.

sp-07378.description_en: As Call Fog, except for the area.

sp-07379.description_en: As Weathershield, except this spell protects the ship from all inclement weather including storms, gales, and winds.

sp-07380.description_en: Caster may control the speed and direction of the wind. Caster can increase or decrease wind speed by 1 mph times his level (e.g., assuming the current wind speed was 20 mph, a 15th level caster could set the wind speed to any speed between 5 mph and 35 mph). By directing the wind against missile attacks, he can cause a -1 modification for each mph of wind. Note that the caster can also control the direction of the flow of gases and/or clouds. The caster may elect to control wind speed in a specified area or to center it upon himself for a mobile radius of effect.

sp-07381.description_en: As Predict Weather V, except the caster has a 95% chance of predicting the weather over a period equal to his level divided by five (round down) in days.

sp-07382.description_en: As Waveshield, except the caster may elect to control the waves in a specified area or to center it upon himself for a mobile radius of effect.

sp-07383.description_en: As Command Winds, except the caster may indicate the weather conditions in the area, modifying wind speeds by +/- 1 mph per level, and setting the intensity of precipitation, fog, cloud cover, etc. Caster may call for shifts in the patterns by concentrating, but any change will take at least d10 minutes. The caster may elect to control the weather in a specified area or to center it upon himself for a mobile radius of effect.

sp-07384.description_en: The caster can summon the forces of nature in a fierce sea storm with wind speeds up to twice his level, waves of 20'-50', and heavy rain. The storm can be delayed up to 1 hour per level. After the storm is summoned, it will dissipate normally. This spell may only be cast at sea (at least 1 mile away from a coastline).

sp-07385.description_en: As Command Current I, except the speed of the ship or boat can be increased by 250' per round (approximately 15 miles per hour).

sp-07386.description_en: As Command Weather, except for the area of effect and range.

sp-07387.description_en: As Command Storms, except for the area of effect and range.
